# 5.A Admin / Investment OS (port 3100)

> Generated from the section drafts of 1 Oct 2026. Evidence labels: [O] observed, [I] inferred, [P] proposed, [V61] documented only in the V61 notes.

#### 5.A.0.1 Admin shell frame and sidebar (`/`, no page permission; items gated per `data-permission`)

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Purpose | Single-route frame (`app-shell`) that hosts all 28 workspaces as in-memory sections, plus the global sidebar, topbar, drawer, modals, toast stack and Copilot entry. |
| Access | The Next.js route `/` is open unless the proxy gate is on (`REQUIRE_AUTH_PORTALS` contains `admin`); when on, a missing or invalid `nexus_session` cookie, or a user with no role whose portal is `admin`, is redirected to `/login?next=<path+query>`; an unreachable API counts as signed out. Each sidebar item is hidden (`display:none`) when the active role lacks its permission. **[O]** |
| Prototype layer | V56 static prototype: markup `02-appshell-open`, `03-sidebar`, `04-main-main-area-open`; behaviour `01-inline.js` (navigate, applyRBAC, toast, drawer), `07-v16-focus-script.js` (short labels, role-focused nav), `v53`/`v54-enhancements.js` (collapse dock); bridge `admin-60-access.js` (access context). |
| Wiring status | Mixed. Role, role labels and role-permission matrix are **Bridged** (`GET /api/v1/admin/access-context`, `GET /api/v1/admin/policy`, `GET /api/v1/admin/settings`) when the user is signed in; otherwise the hard-coded matrix is used (**Prototype**). Navigation state, badges, health text and sync time are **Prototype**. |
| Entry points | Browser URL `/` (always opens Command Centre; no hash, query or history deep links); `/login`, `/invite`, `/reset-password` for authentication; the `?page=` links written into server notifications are ignored by the admin app. |
| Exit points | Sign out (profile drawer) → `/login`; "Open company portal" (Private Markets hub) → new browser tab; every `data-permission` item navigates inside the app. |

##### Layout
1. Boot splash `#mx-boot`: word-mark *matanho*, spinner, label *LOADING WORKSPACE* (`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`); every other body child is `visibility:hidden` until `html[data-legacy-ready]` is set (fail-safe 27 s). **[O]**
2. Left sidebar (`aside#sidebar`): brand logo, workspace chip, V16 workspace toggle, 28 navigation buttons in 3 sections, footer (health line, last sync, collapse dock). **[O]**
3. Main area (`main.main-area`): sticky topbar (5.A.0.2), then exactly one `.page` section visible at a time (animation `v17PageIn` 0.18 s). **[O]**
4. Global overlays after the shell: detail drawer + backdrop, modal backdrop + four legacy modals, Copilot button, chart tooltip, toast stack (5.A.0.4). **[O]**

##### States
- Empty: if RBAC hides every item of a section the section header still shows (outside focused mode). **[O]**
- Loading: boot splash *LOADING WORKSPACE* until scripts and the bridge finish (bridge wait capped at 15 s; fail-safe 27 s). **[O]**
- Error: bridge failure only logs `[admin-bridge] loader failed` / `[mx-bridge] live data unavailable - showing prototype data` to the console; the UI silently falls back to demo data. **[O]**
- Disabled / read-only: none on the sidebar.
- Conditional: (a) focused nav (default): only the active role's primary workspaces are shown under *YOUR WORKSPACE*, other items get `v16-secondary` and are hidden; an unknown role key falls back to the Investment Director list; (b) collapsed rail hides labels; (c) ≤ 980 px the sidebar is off-canvas; (d) `applyRBAC` runs at boot and on every role change: items lacking the active role's permission get `hidden-by-rbac`; if the current page is no longer permitted the app navigates to the **first visible nav item** (e.g. Auditor, who lacks `dashboard.view`, lands on Whole Portfolio). **[O]**

##### Business rules & calculations
- BR-001/BR-002 interplay: nav hiding uses the **selected role's catalogue permissions**; `hasPermission()` uses the union of all permissions of the signed-in user only while the selected role equals the user's primary role from the access context; for any other (preview) role it uses that role's catalogue. The server still enforces real permissions. **[O]**
- Page → permission map (`permissionForPage`): command, copilot → `dashboard.view`; portfolios, private-markets, portfolio-lab, ibor → `portfolio.view`; orders → `orders.view`; research → `research.view`; risk, financing, model-governance → `risk.view`; performance, reports, regulatory → `reports.view`; clients, investor-services → `clients.view`; onboarding → `onboarding.view`; cash → `cash.view`; vault → `documents.view`; operations, reconciliations, corporate-actions, data → `operations.view`; valuation, accounting → `valuation.view`; rbac → `admin.rbac`; settings → `admin.settings`; audit → `audit.view`; second-layer `detail` → permission of its parent page. **[O]**
- Fallback role → permission matrix (used when not signed in) is the one in 4.2 plus `cash.*` codes; live matrix is read from the seeded `role-catalog.json` through the access context. **[O]**
- Initial page is always `command`; the platform setting `startPage` is applied only by the RBAC "preview current role" action, not at boot. **[O]**

##### Edge cases
- Selecting a role in the switcher that cannot open the current page moves the user to the first visible nav item without a "forbidden" toast other than "Role context changed". **[O]**
- A page reached by Alt-shortcut, palette, KPI tile or link that is not in the role's primary list has its nav item hidden, so no item appears active. **[O]**
- The Settings option *Breadcrumbs = off* adds `hide-layer-breadcrumbs` and removes the only Back control of second-layer pages. **[O]**
- Settings *Density = comfortable* adds `density-comfortable` (more padding); the Settings *Timezone* value does not affect the shell clock. **[O]**
- ≤ 980 px: collapse has no effect; ≤ 1280 px market clock and role switcher are hidden, so role switching is impossible on narrow screens. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-001** sidebar badges (4, 5, 7, 3, 5, 8, 4, 3, 3, 4, 14, 8, 2, 4, 3, 2) are hard-coded and never update.
- **DEF-002** health line *All services operational* and *Last sync just now* are static strings; no health or sync call is made.
- **DEF-003** the collapse button's initial `aria-label`/`title` says *Expand sidebar* while the sidebar is expanded (corrected only after the first click).
- **DEF-004** the *28 available* count in the workspace toggle is a constant and ignores RBAC.
- **DEF-005** icon-only collapsed items have no `title`/tooltip.
- **DEF-006** mobile sidebar has no backdrop, outside-click close or Escape close.
- **DEF-007** an empty section header remains when RBAC hides all of its items outside focused mode.
- **DEF-008** live and demo data are indistinguishable in the UI; a failed bridge silently shows demo data.
- FR-UI-001: nav badges show live counts of the user's open work items per page — AC: each badge equals the count returned by the work-item API for that page and is hidden when 0.
- FR-UI-002: collapse state and focused/all workspace mode are stored per user — AC: reload restores both for the same user and not for another user.
- FR-UI-003: the health line reflects integration status — AC: shows *Degraded* with the failing integration name when any integration is `degraded` or `failed`; last-sync time equals the latest successful sync.
- Q-26: should the sidebar section headers hide when empty? — default: yes.

##### Modals & drawers
**Dialog — Two-factor authentication** (bridge `mx.mfaSetup`, overlay with `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, kicker *ACCOUNT SECURITY*).

| Field | Control | Required | Options / default / placeholder | Validation today (code) | Target validation | Error message |

| Control | Enabled when | Permission | Effect | Wiring / API | Label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dialog open | Signed in | none | Calls `GET /api/auth/mfa/status`. Already enrolled: text "Enabled since {dd Mon yyyy}. Approvals and signatures ask for a fresh code." and "Lost your device? Ask a System Administrator to reset your second factor."; button *Done*. Not enrolled: "Preparing a new key…", calls `POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll`, shows the secret in groups of 4, link *Open in authenticator app* (`otpauth://`), code input. Enrol failure text "Could not start two-factor set-up." | Bridged | [O] |
| *Verify & enable* | Code entered | none | `POST /api/auth/mfa/verify {code}`; toast "Two-factor enabled" / "Approvals and signatures will now ask for a code from your authenticator." and dialog closes. | Bridged | [O] |
| *Cancel* / *Done* | Always | none | Closes the dialog. | n/a | [O] |

**Prompt — Step-up confirmation** (`window.prompt`). Any API response `401` with code `step_up_required` triggers the prompt, then `POST /api/auth/mfa/step-up {code}` and **one** automatic retry of the original request; concurrent step-ups are de-duplicated. Cancel/empty → toast "Not saved" / "Confirmation cancelled". Wiring: Bridged. **[O]**

##### States
- Empty: search with no matches shows the *No matching records* drawer body; palette shows "No matching command". **[O]**
- Loading: none (search and palette are synchronous).
- Error: failed API calls in the profile/MFA flow show the generic toast "Not saved" / {API message} or "The server rejected this action." (error tone). **[O]**
- Disabled / read-only: none.
- Conditional: role switcher and profile content differ between signed-in and not-signed-in (see Elements); topbar controls hidden by width (see Layout).

##### Business rules & calculations
- Market open window: Mon–Fri, 09:00 ≤ time < 15:00 Africa/Harare (hard-coded); there is no holiday calendar, no pre-open/auction state and no VFEX state. **[O]**
- Search cap: 3 results per entity type; matching is a case-insensitive substring. **[O]**
- Role switching changes presentation only; real rights come from the server (BR-001, BR-002). **[O]**

##### Edge cases
- Pressing Enter in search opens both the search drawer and the palette on top; the palette filters only its 11 static commands, so entity names normally show "No matching command". **[O]**
- Global search is not permission-filtered: an Analyst (no `orders.view`, no `clients.view`) still sees order and client matches. **[O]**
- Securities, private assets, models and counterparties are not searched although the original placeholder named them. **[O]**
- Role switcher is hidden ≤ 1280 px and the bell ≤ 640 px. **[O]**
- The Settings *timezone* value is ignored by the clock. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-009** search result buttons (*Open →*) have no click handler; nothing opens.
- **DEF-010** search is not permission-filtered, contradicting its own subtitle "across authorised records".
- **DEF-011** Enter in search opens the search drawer and the command palette simultaneously.
- **DEF-012** notification bell badge (*4*) and drawer text are hard-coded; the Settings notification toggles (`notifyRisk`, `notifyOrders`, `notifySettlement`, `notifyResearch`) do not affect them; server-created notifications (e.g. company-portal events for `research.edit` holders) are never displayed.
- **DEF-013** the profile button always shows *Tendai Moyo* / *TM*, even for another signed-in user.
- **DEF-014** the Focus preference is stored per browser origin in `localStorage['matanhoFocus']`, not per user, and in the default (on) state hides every page subtitle quoted elsewhere in this document.
- **DEF-015** the ZSE session indicator ignores public holidays and never reports VFEX.
- **DEF-016** the clock ignores the Settings timezone.
- **DEF-017** the role switcher and market clock vanish ≤ 1280 px.
- FR-UI-004: global search queries a server endpoint and returns only entities the user can view, with working *Open →* navigation — AC: a user without `orders.view` never receives order results; clicking a result opens the entity's page or drawer.
- FR-UI-005: the bell shows the count and list of the user's unread notifications with links and mark-as-read — AC: badge equals unread count; clicking an item navigates and marks it read; honours the user's notification settings.
- FR-UI-006: the profile button shows the signed-in user's name, initials and roles — AC: no static name remains in markup.
- Q-27: should Focus mode default to on? — default: on, stored per user.

- FR-UI-008: a single accessible dialog/drawer component with focus trap, Esc, `aria-live` toasts and a maximum of 4 visible toasts — AC: keyboard-only user can open, operate and close any dialog; screen reader announces toasts.
- FR-UI-009: toast and drawer content are HTML-escaped — AC: a company name containing `<script>` renders as text.

Score cards: heat intensity = score/100, class alert if > 80, warn if > 55, else good; severity *High* > 80, *Material* > 55, else *Low*; mapped exposure = sum of the sleeve's 5 instrument values (US$ x.xxm) with weight = clamp(5 + 0.16·s, 4, 24.5) %; risk contribution = clamp(0.031·s, 0.2, 3.6) %; severe stress = factorStress × s/100 with factorStress *Growth* −12.8, *Rates* −5.6, *FX* −8.9, *Credit* −6.7, *Liquidity* −4.8. Contributors table columns: *Instrument / asset*, *Exposure type*, *Market value*, *Cell contribution* (bar = clamp(base % × (0.72 + 0.42·s/100), 4, 34)), *Severe stress*, *Source* (*IBOR / Risk Cube*). Decision copy: s > 80 *Review before adding exposure*; s > 55 *Monitor and test stressed headroom*; else *Within current risk capacity*. Limits & stress: threshold = 10 + round((100 − s)/10) %; headroom = clamp(22 − 0.21·s, 0.4, 20) %; current = threshold − headroom/10; review state *Action* if s > 80 else *Monitor*. Lineage cards: *IBOR snapshot* (*438 positions · as of 15:42 CAT*), market data prices/FX, risk model *RM-2026-07*, cell output `RISK-CUBE/{FACTOR}/{SLEEVE}/2026-09-01`; disclaimer "Prototype values are illustrative…". **[O]**

##### Business rules & calculations
- Chart series (Prototype): `smoothSeries(anchors, n, amp)` linearly interpolates the anchors and adds `sin(i·1.73)·amp + sin(i·0.61)·amp·0.55` (0 at both ends); points 29 (1M), 35 (3M), 61 (YTD, 1Y); amplitude 0.28 composite, 0.16 benchmark. **[O]**
- Scope formula: composite = series × scale; benchmark = series × (0.96 + 0.04 × scale); scale *whole* 1, *listed* 1.16, *fixed* 0.72, *private* 0.88, *liquidity* 0.48. Y domain = floor/ceil(min, max) ± max(1.4, 12 % of range). **[O]**
- Liquidity floor 1.25× appears as text and as the threshold line; no code compares the KPI to it. **[O]**
- BR-001 (no monetary rights for system admin) and BR-003 (approve ≠ route) are not exercised on this page.
- [P] KPI tile turns amber when the underlying control is within 15 % of its limit and red when breached (not implemented).

##### Edge cases
- Scope *private* shows Private NAV 100 %; *listed*, *fixed*, *liquidity* show 0.0 % with an explanatory note. **[O]**
- A negative active return (scopes *fixed* and *liquidity*) is still rendered with the green `positive-text` class. **[O]**
- A restricted role can see every tile and link; clicking shows "Access restricted" (twice for page jumps). **[O]**
- The Auditor never sees this page (redirect at boot). **[O]**

- **DEF-039** 1M, 3M and YTD all end at 12.84 % / 10.74 % because the series are cumulative YTD levels, not period returns; series are synthetic.

- FR-DASH-002: chart ranges 1M/3M/YTD/1Y show period returns — AC: the 1M end value equals the 1-month return, not the YTD level.
- FR-DASH-003: a KPI tile changes colour when its control is within 15 % of the limit (amber) or breached (red) — AC: liquidity cover below 1.25× turns the tile red.

##### States
- Empty: table body blank when no row matches; holdings: no message defined; layer: *No linked account*, *No linked orders*, "No open orders in the current demo population.", "No dedicated cash account is mapped to this portfolio in the demo data." **[O]**
- Loading: none.
- Error: none.
- Disabled / read-only: *Back* disabled on wizard step 1.
- Conditional: risk badge colour; pill *Within mandate*/*Attention required*; V16 focus nav visibility; new *Setup* portfolios fall back to Balanced Growth profile and holdings at US$ 0.00M.

##### Business rules & calculations
- Holdings market value = `parseAum(portfolio.aum)` × weight / 100 (number before "M"), shown `US$ x.xxM`. **[O]**
- YTD P/L (synthetic): *Cash* 0.8, *Money market* 4.7, *Fixed income* 5.5, *Private* 8.2, all others `6 + (charCodeSum(name) % 115) / 10`. **[O]**
- Source pill chosen by asset class and market (see Tables). **[O]**
- Portfolio name uniqueness is case-insensitive. **[O]**
- [P] Creation requires a permission (Q-05); name 3–120 characters; manager must hold `portfolio_manager`; mandate and benchmark required.

##### Edge cases
- A new portfolio created in the wizard appears with *Setup*, AUM `US$ 0.00`, return/benchmark `—`, and disappears on reload. **[O]**
- The 360 allocation bars can sum above 100 % for high-cash portfolios (Liquidity Plus 24.7 % cash + 37.2 + 28.8 + 18.6 + 10.2). **[O]**
- Filter drawer + main search interplay uses DOM row indices (wrong records evaluated). **[O]**
- Rows with `ZWG` base currency show AUM as "US$ x.xxM eq.". **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-050** strategy and currency selects are rendered but not wired; *6 active portfolios* never updates.
- **DEF-051** *Save view* stores only the search text in `matanho-portfolio-view-v8` and never restores it; not per user.
- **DEF-052** the *More filters* drawer evaluates the wrong records after the main search narrowed the table (row-index match).
- **DEF-053** *+ New portfolio* has no permission check; the evidence file is not stored; the new portfolio and its activation "tasks" are not persisted or created; the wizard has no Esc handler; numeric limits are not validated (no min ≤ max checks).
- **DEF-054** KPI *Available cash* (US$ 7.12M / 8.4 %) and *Weighted TWR* (12.84 % / +2.10 %) do not reconcile with the six rows (≈ US$ 8.11M / 9.6 %; ≈ 13.22 % / +1.84 %); the Command Centre repeats 12.84 % and 84.62M.
- **DEF-055** *YTD return* is always styled positive, including negative values.
- **DEF-056** layer stat *YTD return* sub-text says "Benchmark {x}" but shows the active return.
- **DEF-057** the original layer holdings table reads a non-existent `profile.holdings`; replaced at runtime by V55 through a MutationObserver.
- **DEF-058** Portfolio 360 allocation bars are hard-coded for all portfolios and can exceed 100 %.
- **DEF-059** V55 *Weight shown* sums all rows even when filtered.
- **DEF-060** new *Setup* portfolios inherit Balanced Growth profile, holdings and mandate headroom.
- **DEF-061** rows are not keyboard-focusable; global search result buttons do nothing.
- **DEF-062** Portfolio 360 and layer text "Benchmark {ret − active}%" uses string maths on formatted values.
- FR-PORT-009: portfolios are served by `GET /api/v1/portfolios` with search, strategy, currency, risk and manager filters and saved views per user — AC: strategy and currency selects filter the table; the count equals the number of rows shown; a saved view restores filters for the same user.
- FR-PORT-010: summary KPIs are computed from the rows — AC: Total AUM equals Σ AUM in the base currency; Weighted TWR equals the AUM-weighted return; Open breaches equals the number of open breaches.
- FR-PORT-011: portfolio creation requires a named permission and persists the wizard fields — AC: unauthorised users do not see *+ New portfolio*; the evidence file is stored in the vault; a created portfolio survives reload with state *Setup* and creates real activation tasks.
- BR-022: a portfolio cannot receive orders while in state *Setup*.
- Q-05 (existing): which permission creates portfolios? — default: `admin.settings` plus `portfolio.view` until a dedicated code exists.
- Q-30: should ZAR be offered as base currency in the wizard while the SRD baseline is {USD, ZWG}? — default: keep ZAR (present in the wizard).

Server rules for accept/return: `note` trimmed, max 5000; unknown pack → 404 "Reporting pack not found"; status not submitted → 409 `invalid_state` "The {label} pack is {status}, not awaiting review"; return with empty note → 400 "Explain what the company needs to fix" (a whitespace-only note passes the client check but fails here); the reviewer who submitted the pack gets 403 `sod_violation` "You cannot review a pack you submitted"; on success reviewedAt, reviewer and version+1 are set, audit `reporting.pack.accepted` or `reporting.pack.returned` is written and company users are notified. **[O]**

Server validation: `title` 1–200, `text` 1–5000 (trimmed), `period` `^\d{4}-\d{2}$`, optional `role` ≤ 120; unknown company → 404 "Portfolio company not found"; audit `reporting.question.raised`; company notified. **[O]**

##### States
- Empty: hub overview *Nothing waiting.*; inventory and other tables have no empty state (static). **[O]**
- Loading: hub shows nothing until `matanho:legacy-ready` and again 4 s later; no spinner. **[O]**
- Error: any hub failure → toast "Not saved" / {API message} or "The server rejected this action." (also for read failures); signed out, API down or no API `portfolio.view` → **no hub at all** (company reporting becomes unreachable because the V16 hub was removed). **[O]**
- Disabled / read-only: *Review*, *Return*, *Accept*, *Ask*, *Reply*, *Resolve*, *Invite* are shown only with `research.edit`; otherwise *View* and read-only tables. **[O]**
- Conditional: hub cards warn when counts > 0; tabs *Diligence* and *Valuations* hidden until *More*; forecast cover ring colour by 1.25× floor; asset drawer valuation row by tone.

##### Business rules & calculations
- Forecast: opening liquidity fixed at 7.20; each month `cash += dist − calls − fees − other`; `net = dist − calls − fees` where "fees" = Σ(fees + other); `cover = min(cash) / peak(calls + fees + other)`; scenario multipliers *Downside* calls ×1.28, dist ×0.62, fees ×1.12; *Upside* calls ×0.90, dist ×1.22, fees ×0.95; `other` unscaled. House liquidity floor **1.25×**; floor line plotted at `min(cash)/1.25`. **[O]**
- Superseded V15 scenario data: calls/dists/net/floor Base US$ 2.84M / 1.38M / −1.46M / 1.42×; Downside 3.81M / 0.88M / −2.93M / 1.19×; Upside 2.32M / 1.90M / −0.42M / 1.68×. V35 used default 90D and multipliers ×1.30/0.60/1.12 and ×0.90/1.25/0.95. **[O]**
- Manager concentration warning 20 % (display only). **[O]**
- Hub: SoD "You cannot review a pack you submitted"; accept/return only from status `submitted`; return requires a note. (FR-CMP-005.) **[O]**
- [P] IRR, TVPI, DPI are computed from cash flows (FR-PORT-008).

##### Edge cases
- Downside 12M is the only forecast combination below the 1.25× floor (1.24×). **[O]**
- If *Diligence* or *Valuations* is active and the user clicks *Less*, the tab button disappears but its pane stays displayed. **[O]**
- Every forecast click re-renders the whole panel via innerHTML; V52/V53 add-ons are re-added by observers. **[O]**
- Pack *View* from the company modal cannot return to the company modal. **[O]**
- Hub inputs use `prompt()` dialogs: no inline validation, no multi-line editing. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-063** KPI *12 vehicles* vs 6 inventory rows; *Private NAV* US$ 18.12M vs Σ inventory NAV 14.67M; *Unfunded* US$ 8.74M vs Σ 5.07M; *90-day net cashflow* −US$ 1.46M (V15) vs V44 −US$ 1.00m (90D) / −1.65m (6M); opening liquid assets 7.12 (bridge) vs 7.20 (forecast); Growth Equity IV call 07 Sep (table) vs 08 Sep (forecast).
- **DEF-064** exception 1 states NAV US$ 2.46M while inventory shows US$ 4.46M; exception 2 opens PC-018 (tone green) so its drawer shows "Evidence current." with no covenant data.
- **DEF-065** underlying cards (U-101…U-104) and pipeline items (PIPE-01…03) open a drawer titled with the raw id and "—" values; the `||'US$ 0.84M'` fallback never fires.
- **DEF-066** *Export look-through →* produces no file (shows the intake form).
- **DEF-067** draft drawers persist nothing; "Draft created" is a toast only; amount allows 0; currency list has no ZWG; no vintage, valuation-date or fair-value-level fields.
- **DEF-068** "cover" is `min closing cash / peak monthly outflow` (3–6×), not a coverage ratio, and the floor line `min(cash)/1.25` is not a policy floor.
- **DEF-069** V17 *↗ Drill* on the forecast is destroyed by the V35 rewrite and never re-added.
- **DEF-070** Funding-plan modal and others have no Esc handler.
- **DEF-071** V16 hub removal makes company reporting unreachable when the API is down, the user is signed out or lacks `portfolio.view`; the hub has no loading indicator.
- **DEF-072** the hub's *Open company portal* still targets the replaced Portfolio Company portal URL (port 3103 / `company.{host}`) instead of the Investee portal.
- **DEF-073** company-portal notifications link to `/?page=private-markets`, which the admin app ignores.
- **DEF-074** toasts built from API data (company names, e-mail addresses) use unescaped HTML.
- **DEF-075** `overdue` is styled as a status chip but the backend defines no `overdue` status.
- **DEF-076** hub failure wording "Not saved" is also used for read failures; accept/return/question/reply/invite use browser `prompt()`.
- **DEF-077** nav badge *5* is static.
- FR-PM-001: private investments, pipeline, cash flows and valuations are served from the API (`/v1/private/*` do not exist today) — AC: inventory totals equal the KPI tiles; IRR/TVPI/DPI computed from cash flows.
- FR-PM-002: the *New investment*, *Diligence case* and *Cashflow scenario* drawers persist records and validate (name required, amount > 0, vintage 1990–current, valuation date ≤ today, fair-value level 1–3, currency incl. ZWG) — AC: invalid input shows an inline error; saved record appears in the inventory.
- FR-PM-003: *Export look-through* downloads a CSV of underlying exposures — AC: file rows equal look-through table rows.
- FR-PM-004: the hub is wired to the Investee portal: *Open company portal* opens the Investee portal and the hub exposes *open period* (`POST …/companies/{ref}/periods`) and *update covenant* (`PATCH …/companies/{ref}/covenants/{key}`) — AC: a staff user with `research.edit` can open a period and update a covenant; both actions are audited.
- FR-PM-005: hub review actions use proper dialogs with inline validation instead of `prompt()` — AC: return note required inline; empty reply rejected inline.
- BR-023: house liquidity floor is a policy parameter, not a constant, and "cover" is defined as liquid assets ÷ stressed outflows over the horizon.
- Q-31: where does the hub live now that the V16 hub is removed and company reporting is the Investee portal's counterpart — keep in Private Markets? — default: keep the hub on this page and always render it (empty state when offline).
- Q-32: should `research.edit` remain the permission for company-reporting review? — default: introduce a dedicated `investee.review` permission; keep `research.edit` until seeded.

#### 5.A.4 Portfolio Construction (`portfolio-lab`, `portfolio.view`)

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Purpose | Adjust target weights per sleeve, review constraints and scenario comparison, and "promote" an optimised target to the order workflow. |
| Access | `portfolio.view` (all 10 fallback roles). No action on the page checks a permission: every role that can open the page can run the optimiser and press *Promote to Orders*. In V16 focused nav the item is primary only for Portfolio Manager and Analyst. **[O]** |
| Prototype layer | `09-page-portfolio-lab` markup (already the V33 rebuild) and `v33-rebuild.js` (`initConstruction`, final). No later layer (V34–V56) or bridge file touches this page. Superseded and dead: `01-inline.js` optimiser/scenario actions and `02-v7…js` V8/V9 scenario library. |
| Wiring status | Prototype (all in memory; no localStorage, no API). `/v1/construction/*` does not exist. |
| Entry points | Sidebar *Construction*; the risk-limit layer button *Re-optimise portfolio*. No palette command, no shortcut, no deep link. |
| Exit points | *Promote to Orders* → orders (then "Access restricted" for roles without `orders.view`). |

##### Modals & drawers
None. (Superseded and unreachable: V8/V9 scenario library, compare drawer, new-scenario drawer, "How to create a scenario" guide, `compare-scenarios` drawer with *Balanced* 13.6 % · 6.9 % TE, *Defensive* 11.9 % · 5.2 %, *Growth* 15.1 % · 7.4 %.)

##### States
- Empty: none.
- Loading: none.
- Error: error toast on invalid weight total only.
- Disabled / read-only: *Promote to Orders* disabled until an optimiser run succeeded; gate chips *Required* / *Blocked* before.
- Conditional: weight-total chip `pass`/`warn`; promotion gates:
  - *Weights*: *Pass* if `|total − 100| < 0.1`, else *Fail*.
  - *Optimiser*: *Run complete* if optimised, else *Required*.
  - *PM approval*: *Ready* if optimised, else *Blocked* (no real approval step).

##### Business rules & calculations
- Weight tolerance: chip and gate use `< 0.1`; optimiser blocks on `> 0.1`; effective tolerance is exactly 100.0 because the slider step is 0.5. **[O]**
- Each sleeve is bounded 0–50 %, so negative (short) weights are impossible. **[O]**
- Superseded dead code (not reachable): V8 `saveActiveScenarioV8` required |total − 100| ≤ 0.05 ("Target weights must equal 100%"); V9 `promoteScenarioOrdersV9` required `orders.create`, blocked re-staging ("Scenario already staged") and created four Draft orders `SCN-{nnnn}-0x` (DLTA.ZW, INN.ZW, T-BILL-91D, ZIM.VX) in the legacy order array; seed scenarios SCN-04 *Strategic rebalance* (targets 35 / 16.5 / 27 / 10 / 11.5, TE 7.5, cash 6, turnover 12), SCN-DEF *Defensive liquidity*, SCN-GRW *Growth tilt*; storage `localStorage['matanho-scenarios-v8']`; 01-inline `runInstitutionalOptimizer` results `[return, TE, turnover, cost]` balanced 13.6 %, 6.9 %, 8.7 %, 18 bps; defensive 11.9 %, 5.2 %, 6.1 %, 14 bps; growth 15.1 %, 7.4 %, 10.8 %, 23 bps. **[O]**
- FR-PORT-005/006/007 are not met by the final UI. [P] Hard limits block promotion; soft limits require rationale and approval; every proposed order is re-tested at creation (legacy `constraint-detail` drawer text).

##### Edge cases
- `optimised` is never reset when sliders change afterwards: promotion works while the *Weights* gate shows *Fail*. **[O]**
- Analyst and Client Services lack `orders.view`: they see the success toast "Scenario promoted", then "Access restricted", and stay on the page. **[O]**
- *Save scenario* succeeds with weights ≠ 100 %. **[O]**
- All state resets on reload. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-078** KPI strip is static; sliders and the optimiser never change any KPI, scenario row or trade.
- **DEF-079** *Run optimiser* performs no computation (only the 100 % check, then jumps to *Scenarios*); constraint inputs are ignored and reset on every re-render.
- **DEF-080** *Save scenario* is toast-only (no name, no persistence, no validation); `matanho-scenarios-v8` belongs to dead V8 code.
- **DEF-081** *Promote to Orders* creates no orders, checks no `orders.create` (the SRD's 5.A.4 rule applied only to dead V9 code), and never resets `optimised`.
- **DEF-082** the implementation trade table is static and independent of the targets.
- **DEF-083** *PM approval* gate is cosmetic.
- **DEF-084** constraint inputs have no units; the strategy limits do not reference existing risk limits.
- **DEF-085** no permission gates on *Run optimiser* / *Save scenario* / *Promote*.
- FR-PORT-012: constraints are bound to effective limits and used by the optimiser — AC: changing *Single issuer maximum* changes the proposed trades; violating a hard constraint blocks promotion.
- FR-PORT-013: KPIs and scenario table are produced by the optimiser job — AC: after a run, every KPI equals the job result with its as-of time.
- FR-PORT-014: *Promote to Orders* requires `orders.create`, creates one Draft order per trade line and is idempotent — AC: promoting twice does not create duplicates; success toast shows the number of drafts; users without `orders.create` see the button disabled with a tooltip.
- FR-PORT-015: *Save scenario* asks for a name, persists weights and constraints and lists saved scenarios — AC: reload shows the scenario in a list; delete is available to the owner.
- BR-024: a scenario whose weights do not sum to 100 ± 0.01 cannot be saved, optimised or promoted.
- Q-33: can short weights be allowed per mandate? — default: no (slider minimum 0).

##### States
- Empty: "No securities match your search."; "No orders for this security."; "No matching security."; empty working-orders and Approvals tables as above. **[O]**
- Loading: ticket buttons show "Saving…", "Running checks…", "Submitting…"; no data loading states. **[O]**
- Error: error toasts quoted above; none from the network (no API).
- Disabled / read-only: *Submit for approval* disabled until a check passes; broker *Send* disabled unless *Approved* + `orders.route`; Order 360 modal read-only.
- Conditional: suspended and delisting-review securities are listed and orderable; chart ranges differ between page (1M/3M/1Y) and ticket (1D/1M/3M/1Y); sub-tab labels differ before and after a list click; the *More metrics* label resets on re-render.

##### Business rules & calculations
- **Cash ledger and formulas** (V56): currency = security currency; `gross = qty × price`; `fees = gross × 0.0065` (*Estimated dealing costs 0.65%*); Buy `after = balance − (gross + fees)`; Sell `after = balance + gross − fees`; state *fail* if `after < 0` (red `#c33445`, "Insufficient available cash"), *warn* if `balance > 0` and `after / balance < 0.15` (amber `#a46008`, "Low residual cash"), else *good* (green `#0a795c`, "Estimated post-trade cash"). Worked example (defaults, DLTA): consideration ZWG 37,300, costs ZWG 242, after ZWG 18,422,458 (good), participation 8.3 %, issuer 7.80 %. **[O]**
- **Pre-trade check** (V56): required portfolio, qty > 0, price > 0, broker (error toast "Complete the instruction" / "Add {missing} before running pre-trade checks."); button "Running checks…" disabled 320 ms; issues: Buy with `after < 0` → "available cash shortfall {amount}"; participation `qty / volume × 100 > 25` → "high ADV participation x.x%". **Blocked** only when there are issues **and** `after < 0`: the check is cleared and the error toast reads "Pre-trade check failed" / "{issues joined ' · '}". Otherwise it **passes**, storing the fingerprint (ticker | side | portfolio | qty | price | type | tif | settlement | broker | route | trimmed rationale); toast "Pre-trade check complete" / "Mandate, cash, concentration and liquidity checks passed.", or when issues remain "Core controls passed; human review: {issues}". V44 *Review* rows (> 12 % ADV, consideration thresholds, issuer > 9.5 %) neither block nor flag the check. **[O]**
- **Invalidation:** any input/change in the ticket, a side or preset click, or a security change resets the check to *Draft* and disables Submit; changing the chart range does not. **[O]**
- **Result vocabulary in the final UI** is *Pass* / *Review* / *Fail* per control, not *Within / Review / Blocked* (that vocabulary belongs to the legacy engine). Legacy engine thresholds (dead DOM): cash *fail* < 0, *warn* < 8 % of cash; single issuer *warn* > 9 %, *fail* > 10 %; equities *warn* > 38 %, *fail* > 40 %; liquidity *warn* > 80 % and *fail* > 100 % of the route participation limit (default 15 % ADV); checks *Ownership*, *Cash*, *Single issuer*, *Asset-class*, *Liquidity*, *Security eligibility*, *Counterparty*, *SSI* (VFEX + IH warn), *Duplicate* (warn); summary "n passed · n review · n blocked". **[O]**
- **State machine as implemented:** ticket *Draft* → (check passes) *Pre-trade checked / Ready for approval* → (any edit) *Draft*; ready → confirm → *Awaiting approval* (localStorage only). Blotter seed states *Working*, *Awaiting approval*, *Approved*, *Filled*; the only transition is *Awaiting approval* → *Approved* via the Approvals button. Legacy drawer adds *Routing*, *Partially filled*, *Rejected*, *Cancelled* (see table above). Hidden V45 reference lifecycle: *Decision*, *Draft*, *Pre-trade*, *Approval*, *Route*, *Execute*, *Allocate*, *Settle*, *Reconcile*, *Book/close* with an *Advance* button. No cancel, amend or reject UI exists on the Orders page. **[O]**
- BR-001, BR-003 and FR-OMS-006 (approver ≠ creator, `orders.approve`, `orders.route`) are **not enforced** on the Orders page; maker-checker exists only in the legacy drawer, only at role level, only when policy `orderApproval === 'independent'`.

##### Edge cases
- Any ZSE buy from *USD Equity Fund* fails the cash check (ZWG balance 0). **[O]**
- Changing the security inside the ticket discards all entered values. **[O]**
- The V56 MutationObserver re-renders the cash panel on every frame while the ticket is open. **[O]**
- Suspended/delisting securities remain selectable. **[O]**
- The V37 *Working orders* sub-tab shows a synthetic extra row per ticker. **[O]**
- Startup race: before V44 boots, `N` opens the older V37 ticket. **[O]**
- localStorage keys written: `matanho-v56-order-draft` (write-only), `matanho-v56-submitted-orders` (≤ 100, never read), `matanho-v53-submitted-orders` (≤ 50 mirror), `matanho-v37-orders` (read by *Working orders*, written only by the superseded V37 ticket), `matanho-v37-order-draft`, `matanho-v37-imported-orders`, `matanho-v53-order-draft`, `matanho-v44-order-draft` (superseded), `matanho-v39-orders-metrics` (`'open'`/`'closed'`, hidden toggle). **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-086** submitted orders are written only to localStorage and never appear in the blotter, Approvals tab or *Working orders*.
- **DEF-087** no RBAC or segregation of duties on the page: any `orders.view` role (including Compliance, Operations, Auditor, Fund Accountant, System Administrator) can open the ticket, submit and press *Approve*; `orders.create`, `orders.approve` and `orders.route` are never checked by V33–V56; the approver may equal the creator (violates BR-003 / FR-OMS-006).
- **DEF-088** *Approve* has no *Reject*, no reason capture and only approves the first awaiting order.
- **DEF-089** the broker modal cannot be reached from the Orders page; *Send* only sets status *Routing* and transmits nothing.
- **DEF-090** the saved draft (`matanho-v56-order-draft`) is never restored.
- **DEF-091** suspended (CFI, COTT, HCCL, PPC, TRUW, BIND) and delisting-review (EDGR) securities are orderable.
- **DEF-092** V44 *Review* flags (> 12 % ADV, consideration > 450,000 USD / 1,200,000 ZWG, issuer > 9.5 %) disagree with V56 blocking rule (cash only; ADV > 25 % advisory); *Mandate eligibility* is always *Pass*.
- **DEF-093** Stop limit has no stop price; Market orders still require a price; no integer, board-lot or price-tolerance check.
- **DEF-094** sub-tab labels differ before and after selecting a security; the initial pane's range and Line/Area buttons have no effect; *More metrics* label desynchronises after re-render.
- **DEF-095** the hidden V45 listener shows "Order added to lifecycle" before the confirmation with a different id.
- **DEF-096** ticket and confirmation have no Esc handler; platform-setting defaults (portfolio, order type) are not applied.
- **DEF-097** the KPI strip, Import and Post-trade are hidden, so FR-OMS-010 and FR-OMS-011 have no reachable UI; the blotter has no filters or export (FR-OMS-012).
- **DEF-098** blotter limit prices are inconsistent with the security master (DLTA 63.5 vs 3.73); Research page shows DLTA ZWG 31.94 vs 3.73 here.
- **DEF-099** legacy order array vs Orders-page seed are two unrelated stores (order-approval layer, Portfolio layer and Portfolio Construction operate on the legacy array); V9 *Promote to orders* wrote to the legacy array which this blotter never displayed.
- **DEF-100** palette/Shift+O *New order* and *DLTA.ZW market workspace* open nothing; `N` fires twice; issuer logos call external services (`logos.hunter.io`, Google favicon).
- **DEF-101** security master prices are synthetic ("Exchange security-master snapshot · refresh required"); ZSE quotes in ZWG and VFEX in USD; no `/v1/securities` or `/v1/brokers`.
- FR-OMS-013: submitted orders are created through `POST /api/v1/orders` (+ `/validate`, `/submit`) and appear in the blotter, Approvals tab and *Working orders* — AC: reload keeps the order; creator, time and snapshot of controls are stored.
- FR-OMS-014: `orders.create`, `orders.approve` and `orders.route` are enforced in the UI and API; the approver must differ from the creator — AC: a creator pressing *Approve* gets 403 "Maker-checker conflict"; Compliance cannot create orders.
- FR-OMS-015: *Reject* with required reason and *Cancel* with reason — AC: cancel releases the cash reservation; rejected orders show the reason in Order 360.
- FR-OMS-016: securities with status *Suspended* or *Delisting review* cannot be ordered — AC: *New order* is disabled with tooltip naming the status.
- FR-OMS-017: pre-trade result per control is *Pass* / *Review* / *Fail* with an overall *Within* / *Review* / *Blocked*; Review items require a documented reason before submit — AC: Blocked cannot be submitted; Review needs reason text.
- FR-OMS-018: ticket validation — quantity integer and multiple of board lot; price within ±10 % of last unless an override reason is given; stop price required for *Stop limit* — AC: violations show inline field errors.
- FR-OMS-019: saved drafts are listed and restorable by their creator — AC: reopening the ticket offers "Resume draft".
- FR-OMS-020: the blotter has status, portfolio, security and date filters, sort and CSV export — AC: export matches the filters.
- FR-OMS-021: broker routing is reachable from an *Approved* order in the blotter and requires `orders.route` — AC: the preview shows the stored instruction; send changes status to *Routing* and records delivery.
- BR-025: the displayed order-state vocabulary is the one in Appendix B (*Draft*, *Validated*, *Awaiting approval*, *Approved*, *Rejected*, *Routing*, *Partially filled*, *Filled*, *Settled*, *Cancelled*); *Pre-trade checked* maps to *Validated*.
- BR-026: the dealing cost buffer (0.65 %), residual-cash warning (15 %), ADV advisory (25 %) and review thresholds (12 %, 450k/1.2m, 9.5 %) are configurable policy parameters.
- Q-34: should ZSE buys be allowed from a portfolio with no ZWG dealing account (e.g. USD Equity Fund)? — default: no (fail).
- Q-35: which of the two cash estimates (V54 dead, V56 live) is canonical? — default: V56 (0.65 % buffer).

##### Modals & drawers
**Layer — Research case** (`research-case`, parent research, `research.view`). Openers: *Open full investment case →* (selected ticker), *New investment case* (DLTA.ZW), Command Centre decision queue and work queue (always INN.ZW), legacy list (dead). Title "{ticker} · {name}" with name mapping DLTA.ZW → *Delta Corporation*, ZIM.VX → *Zimplats Holdings*, **anything else → *Innscor Africa*** (so CBZ.ZW, ECO.ZW and MEIK.ZW are titled "… · Innscor Africa"); the body is identical for every ticker. Eyebrow *SECURITY RESEARCH · INVESTMENT CASE*; subtitle "A second-level research workspace that separates thesis, valuation, catalysts, committee judgement and evidence from the broader research universe."; breadcrumb *← Research & IC*. Stats (static): *Recommendation* *Accumulate* (*Approved research view*), *Target upside* *+18.0%* (*Base case*), *Confidence* *High* (*Evidence current*), *IC status* *2 votes pending* (*Quorum 4 / 6*), *Next review* *30 Sep 2026* (*Or material catalyst*). Actions *Evidence* → vault, *Stage order* → orders (needs `orders.view`; Analyst is refused). Wiring: Prototype. **[O]**

##### Business rules & calculations
- Valuation range (only Target price matters): **Bear** = target × **0.82**; **Base** = target; **Bull** = target × **1.18**; empty target falls back to the saved model target; format "x.xx ZWG cents" if the price string contains "ZWG cents", "ZWG x.xx" if it starts with "ZWG", else plain. Results: DLTA ZWG 29.60 / 36.10 / 42.60; CBZ ZWG 35.67 / 43.50 / 51.33; ECO 672.40 / 820.00 / 967.60 ZWG cents; MEIK 2.95 / 3.60 / 4.25 ZWG cents. Revenue growth, margin and discount rate feed no formula. **[O]**
- Hero colour: `market-down` when the change string contains "−" (U+2212). **[O]**
- FR-RES-002 (model saved by `research.edit` with version history), FR-RES-003 (notes timestamped and attributed), FR-RES-004 (filing stored in vault) are **not met** by the final UI.

##### Edge cases
- MEIK seed recommendation *Review* is not in the select options; saving MEIK sets the recommendation to an empty string, blanking the hero badge and the list `<em>`. **[O]**
- Saving the model or a note re-renders the whole security view and discards unsaved text in the other tab. **[O]**
- ECO and MEIK model targets (820.00 and 3.60) are in a different unit from their prices (679.53 and 313.00 ZWG cents; MEIK target 3.60 vs price 313 cents). **[O]**
- Only one note per ticker is kept; saving an empty note shows *No session notes yet*. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-102** `research.edit` is not enforced; any `research.view` role (including Dealer and System Administrator) can save models and notes; saves are in memory only (lost on reload), with no versioning, approval or audit although the toast says "controlled model update".
- **DEF-103** the Auditor, Compliance and Operations cannot see research evidence at all (no `research.view`).
- **DEF-104** *Import filing* is a file picker + toast only (no upload, metadata, validation, list update).
- **DEF-105** *New investment case* opens a static case layer for DLTA.ZW; no creation form; the case layer's title maps every non-DLTA/ZIM ticker to "Innscor Africa"; layer stats and drivers are static and not linked to the saved model; the IC tab has no vote actions.
- **DEF-106** recommendation badge always blue; MEIK seed *Review* outside the option list; hero *Internal target*/*Upside* not refreshed after *Save model*.
- **DEF-107** *Reset* restores the last saved values, not the original seed.
- **DEF-108** "Autosave simulated in session" text; no autosave; note history shows a single entry without author or time.
- **DEF-109** model validation ranges (SRD: growth −100…+500 %, margin −100…100 %, discount 0–50 %, conviction 1–5) are not implemented; conviction is letter grades; empty numbers save as 0.
- **DEF-110** price conflict between pages: DLTA ZWG 31.94 here and in legacy order data vs ZWG 3.73 in the Orders security master; DLTA issuer utilisation 91 % here vs 97.2 % on the order record.
- **DEF-111** universe tab *VFEX* is always empty; source bar counts (*4 issuer workspaces*, *4 loaded*, *2*, *4*) are static.
- **DEF-112** price history only for DLTA and CBZ; status text *Delayed public observations* never changes; filings have no files, downloads or vault links; *Refresh sources* is toast-only.
- **DEF-113** dead legacy code (`renderResearch`, segmented filter) remains.
- FR-RES-006: the issuer universe, prices, financials and filings are served from `/v1/research/issuers*` with an as-of and source on every value — AC: the Orders security master and this page show the same last price for the same security and timestamp.
- FR-RES-007: saving a model requires `research.edit`, validates ranges (growth −100…500 %, margin −100…100 %, discount 0–50 %, target > 0 in the quote unit), keeps a version history and updates the hero target and upside — AC: a role without `research.edit` sees *Save model assumptions* disabled; each save creates a version with author and time.
- FR-RES-008: analyst notes are a timestamped, attributed list with catalysts and risks as structured entries — AC: *+ Catalyst* adds a catalyst record with date and trigger; history lists all entries newest first.
- FR-RES-009: *Import filing* collects issuer, document type and period, stores the file in the vault and lists it in the filings tab — AC: the document appears in the list and in Document Vault with the same version.
- FR-RES-010: *New investment case* opens a creation form and an IC workflow with vote, dissent and decision lock — AC: a case has quorum, votes and a decision record; the layer title always matches the ticker.
- BR-027: recommendation list is *Buy*, *Accumulate*, *Hold*, *Reduce*, *Sell*, plus *Review* as an explicit status if kept; conviction scale is defined once (letters or 1–5).
- Q-36: should Compliance and Auditor have read access to research evidence? — default: yes, read-only (`research.view`).
- Q-37: is conviction a letter grade (A…C) or a 1–5 score? — default: letter grade as implemented.

##### States
- Empty: import preview "No file selected."; "No data rows found."; limit table has no empty state. **[O]**
- Loading: none.
- Error: import parse error toast "Import failed" / "The file could not be parsed."
- Disabled / read-only: *Register source run* disabled until a file or sample is parsed.
- Conditional: usage ≥ 85 % warn style; state chip colour; *Decision state* text; heat labels; suggested action by severe score; source cards change after imports.

##### Business rules & calculations
- **Scenario lab** (`riskScenarioCalc37`, final): `loss = eq × 0.21 + fx × 0.09 − rates × 0.0016 − red × 0.12` (%); `liq = max(0.72, 1.84 − red × 0.031 + eq × 0.004)` (×); `cash = 1.12 − red × 0.136` (US$m); `state = (liq < 1.25 || loss < −8) ? 'Escalate' : (liq < 1.5 || loss < −5) ? 'Review' : 'Within'`. Defaults (−20 / −15 / 150 / 10) give **−6.99 %**, **1.45×**, **−US$ 0.24m**, **Review** (markup placeholders −8.15 % / 1.49×). **[O]**
- **Stress contribution chart:** `Equity = eq × 0.21`, `FX = fx × 0.09`, `Rates = −rates × 0.0016`, `Redemptions = −red × 0.12`. **[O]**
- **Limit book:** `usage = clamp(current / threshold × 100, 0, 120)`; warn when ≥ **85**; `headroom = max(0, threshold − current)`; state chip *Within* green, any other amber. The 30-day liquidity cover limit is a **floor** (minimum) but is treated as a maximum: usage 147 % (bar capped), row flagged warn, headroom shown 0.00× although cover is 0.59× above the floor. **[O]**
- **Factor action:** severe ≥ 90 → *Review before risk-taking*; otherwise *Monitor*. **[O]**
- Superseded V7 lab: `loss = eq × 0.28 + fx × 0.10 − |rates| × 0.007`; `cover = max(0.25, 1.84 − red × 0.035)`; `cash = 7.12 − 84.62 × red/100 + 1.10`; *Escalate* if cover < 1.25 or loss < −10, *Review* if cover < 1.5 or loss < −7; reasons "Liquidity below 1.25× floor", "Stress loss above 10% tolerance", "Liquidity near floor", "Stress loss requires review", "Inside current risk appetite"; presets *liquidity* −8 / −5 / 50 / 20, *equity* −30 / 0 / 0 / 5, *fx* −10 / −25 / 100 / 8; the library showed *Large client redemption* (*20% AUM · 30 day view*), *Equity drawdown* (*−30% equities · rates flat*), *Currency shock* (*ZWG −25% · equities −10%*); *Save scenario* prepended a *Saved* row. **[O]**
- FR-RSK-001…005: not met by the final UI (see defects). BR-005 (policy relaxations flagged) is not exercised here.
- House liquidity floor **1.25×**; issuer limit 10 % (Delta 9.10 %); equities 40 % (37.20 %); USD exposure 65 % (54.70 %); illiquid 25 % (15.40 %). **[O]**

##### Edge cases
- Rebuilding the page (after saving a limit or registering an import) resets the scenario inputs to −20 / −15 / 150 / 10. **[O]**
- Amending a limit replaces the effective row with a *Draft*: the effective rule disappears and no old or new version is kept. **[O]**
- An imported limit row is added as *Draft* with current 0 and stress 0 even if it duplicates an existing limit. **[O]**
- Heat cell label (75/50) and drill severity (80/55) can disagree for the same cell. **[O]**
- Between about 0 and 1.15 s after boot the V7 page is visible and the V7 handlers apply. **[O]**
- Modals use modal37 / V44 / V50: no Esc except V50. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-114** `risk.manage` is never enforced (only a catalogue label); any `risk.view` role can draft/amend limits, import sources and open the case form; FR-RSK-002 (limits require approval) and FR-RSK-004 (cases require `risk.manage`) are not implemented.
- **DEF-115** the V37 *+ Case* modal has no footer or submit button, so a compliance case can never be created; its subtitle promises due date, portfolio and evidence fields that do not exist.
- **DEF-116** the `risk-case` layers (AML, mandate) are unreachable from the page; the compliance-queue rows now navigate to onboarding and orders.
- **DEF-117** the limit modal has no validation, ignores the *Effective date* it shows and has no *Owner*; amend overwrites the effective row; there is no approve/activate step, so "draft awaiting approval" is copy only; all limit state is in memory.
- **DEF-118** the 30-day liquidity cover limit (a floor) is evaluated as a maximum (usage 147 %, headroom 0.00×).
- **DEF-119** banner *Severe stress −8.42 %* disagrees with the lab default −6.99 %; budget footer *Stress buffer 3 bps* disagrees with V44 headroom 0.06×; liquidity numbers differ between V37 (min stress 1.28), V38 (1.28), V44 (1.31) and the Command Centre mini chart (2.08× now vs 1.84×); heat labels (75/50) vs V50 severity (80/55); report pack VaR limit 3.00 % has no counterpart in the limit book.
- **DEF-120** *Save scenario* persists nothing; the scenario library and presets (*liquidity*, *equity*, *fx*) were removed; scenario portfolio, horizon and name inputs were removed; *Decision state* has no reason text or colour.
- **DEF-121** imports change only the source cards and add *Draft* limits without validation or de-duplication; positions never affect any risk number.
- **DEF-122** the compliance report is a static preview (static timestamp "01 Sep 2026 · 04:08 CAT", fixed numbers) with no print/download and does not reflect session changes; it is not the Report Editor *Compliance Monitoring Report* any more.
- **DEF-123** banner, KPIs, budget, signals and compliance queue are static (e.g. *Open compliance 3*, *Human action 5*, nav badge *3*).
- **DEF-124** `/v1/risk/*` endpoints do not exist; no breaches are created (FR-RSK-003).
- **DEF-125** no Esc handler on modal37 / V44 modals; no focus management.
- FR-RSK-006: limits are served and managed by `/v1/risk/limits` with states *Draft*, *Pending approval*, *Active*, *Retired*, require `risk.manage` to draft and a different user to approve, and are versioned with an effective date — AC: amending a limit creates a new version and keeps the effective rule until the new version is approved.
- FR-RSK-007: limit evaluation distinguishes maxima and minima — AC: *30d liquidity cover* with current 1.84× and floor 1.25× shows usage ≤ 100 % and headroom 0.59×.
- FR-RSK-008: the limit form validates metric from a catalogue, scope from existing portfolios, threshold > 0, unit, action, owner and effective date — AC: invalid input shows inline errors; effective date is stored.
- FR-RSK-009: compliance cases can be created, assigned and tracked (*Open*, *Investigating*, *Resolved*, *Closed*) from the page — AC: *+ Case* modal has *Create case* and *Cancel*; the description is required ("Record the issue before creating a controlled case."); the case appears in the queue and opens its case layer; only `risk.manage` can create.
- FR-RSK-010: scenario runs are persisted and listed with presets (*liquidity*, *equity*, *fx*) and deterministic results from positions and shocks — AC: *Save scenario* adds a named entry; *Run scenario* returns the same result for the same inputs.
- FR-RSK-011: the banner, KPIs, budget and signals are computed from the same source as the limit book and scenario lab — AC: banner *Severe stress* equals the latest saved severe scenario result; *Closest limit* equals the highest usage.
- FR-RSK-012: imports validate columns, reject invalid rows and update the risk numbers — AC: importing a positions file changes the position count and the exposures; duplicates in a limits file are rejected.
- FR-RSK-013: the compliance report is generated from live data and can be printed or downloaded — AC: report values equal the limit book at the as-of time.
- BR-028: usage ≥ 85 % of a maximum limit (or ≤ 115 % of a minimum limit) is *Tight*; a breach creates a case and notifies the limit owner.
- BR-029: the scenario state thresholds (liquidity 1.25× / 1.5×, loss −8 % / −5 %) are configurable policy parameters.
- Q-38: which approver may activate a draft limit (Compliance, Risk, Investment Director)? — default: a user with `risk.manage` who is not the maker.
- Q-39: is the severe scenario in the banner a fixed preset or the latest saved run? — default: a fixed preset named *Severe cross-asset*.

**Chart specification [O]**

- Type: canvas chart drawn in the browser, DPR-aware, minimum 320 × 220 CSS px, wrapper height 390 px (320 px at widths up to 640 px), redrawn on container resize. Dark palette (background `#0c1728`, gridlines `#21334e`) when the dark theme is active, otherwise white. The canvas is focusable (tab stop) but has no keyboard handlers.
- Series: 170 points evenly spaced in time from 2 Jan 2026 to 30 Aug 2026. Portfolio anchors (cumulative %): 0, 0.7, 1.65, 3.05, 4.12, 6.18, 8.22, 9.02, 11.02, 12.84. Benchmark anchors: 0, 0.48, 1.16, 2.14, 3.02, 4.63, 6.08, 7.0, 8.72, 10.74. For point i (0–169): t = i ÷ 169 × 9; linear interpolation between anchor floor(t) and floor(t)+1; wave = sin(i × 0.31) × 0.08 + sin(i × 0.087) × 0.12; portfolio = interpolated anchor + wave; benchmark = interpolated anchor + wave × 0.42; active = portfolio − benchmark; drawdown = portfolio − running maximum of portfolio (zero or negative). The last point is therefore near, but not exactly, 12.84 / 10.74.
- Range windows: *1M* 22 points, *3M* 65 points, *YTD* 170 points, *1Y* 170 points (identical to YTD because the series has only 170 points).
- Axes: six horizontal gridlines; y labels "<value>%" with 0 decimals in Cumulative mode and 1 decimal in Active return and Drawdown modes; y domain = min(0, values) to max(0, values) with padding = max(0.3, 12% of the span); six x labels, dates formatted "d Mon" (en-GB, e.g. "2 Jan").
- Cumulative mode: portfolio line `#3158e8` 2.1 px with a halo, blue area fill fading from 18% opacity to 0, benchmark as a grey dashed line (dash 6 / gap 5). Active return mode: zero line, purple line `#6b5cf0`, thin bars about every 1/18th of the visible points (green when active is zero or positive, red when negative). Drawdown mode: red gradient area between zero and the drawdown line `#d85068`.
- Event markers (all modes): small triangles at 28% (*Cash flow*, green), 57% (*Rebalance*, blue) and 80% (*IC decision*, purple) of the visible points. The marker labels are defined but not drawn; markers have no tooltip and no click action.
- Pointer move: dashed crosshair and dot at the nearest point; floating tooltip with the date ("dd Mon yyyy"), "Portfolio x.xx% · Benchmark x.xx%" and "Active ±x.xx% · drawdown x.xx%" (two decimals). Pointer leave hides the tooltip and crosshair.
- Wheel: zooms about the cursor; wheel down enlarges the window by 15%, wheel up shrinks it by 16%; window never smaller than 20 points and never larger than the selected range. Double-click resets the zoom. Click opens the "PBOR · LINKED PERFORMANCE" drawer for the nearest point.
- The generic "↗ Drill" button added to other charts is deliberately not added to this chart.

##### States

- Empty: **[O]** none; every figure is static. A portfolio or period with no return data has no designed state **[I]**.
- Loading: **[O]** none; the chart is drawn immediately from the generated series.
- Error: **[O]** none; no network calls are made, so there is no failure path.
- Disabled / read-only: **[O]** the whole page is read-only apart from range, mode, zoom and navigation. *Lock official return* is never disabled even though it can never succeed.
- Conditional: **[O]** chart style follows the light or dark theme; the page subtitle is hidden when Focus mode is on (default; stored in browser storage key `matanhoFocus`, value `off` disables it); the sidebar item is hidden for roles without `reports.view`; the chart is redrawn each time the page is opened (about 80 ms after navigation) and on container resize.
- Persistence: **[O]** no page-specific storage. Chart range, mode and zoom are held in memory only and reset on reload. The browser key `matanho-rbac-v8` affects visibility only when the live access context is not available (see Appendix C).

##### Business rules & calculations

- **[O]** Return basis stated on the page: net time-weighted return, daily geometric chaining, approved composite benchmark, external cash flows neutralised, fees included per mandate, effective-dated methodology and benchmark (text only; the chart series is synthetic and not chained). Existing BR-016 applies (daily TWR chain-linked; Brinson per sector vs benchmark).
- **[O]** Active return = Portfolio − Benchmark (12.84% − 10.74% = 2.10%).
- **[O]** The bridge components sum to the active return: 1.31 + 0.64 + 0.33 − 0.18 = 2.10 (percent).
- **[O]** Brinson row identity: Total active = Allocation + Selection + Interaction (for example 18 + 61 + 5 = 84 bps).
- **[O]** The explorer contributor rows sum to the active return: 0.96 + 0.45 + 0.30 + 0.39 = 2.10 (percent).
- **[I]** Official-return state machine: Provisional → Official (locked); only Provisional exists in the UI; the lock is refused while any of the five controls is not done.
- BR-030: A performance period may be locked only when all five controls (IBOR positions reconciled, cash reconciled, valuation sources approved, composite membership review, fees and flows validated) are done, and only by a user other than the preparer; once Official the period is immutable and corrections create a new version with a reason **[P]**.
- BR-031: Locking, export and methodology-version changes each write an audit event with user, time, period and result **[P]**.
- BR-032: Period, return basis and State shown on the control bar must come from the same record as the KPI *Official state* **[P]**.

##### Edge cases

- **[O]** *1Y* shows the same data as *YTD* because the series has only 170 points.
- **[O]** The chart window cannot be zoomed below 20 points, so *1M* (22 points) can barely be zoomed.
- **[O]** The legend, KPIs, control-bar *Period* and table never change with range, mode or zoom.
- **[O]** The last chart point is near but not exactly the KPI value because of the added wave term.
- **[O]** A click on the chart always opens the drawer for the nearest point, including during a zoom.
- **[O]** Roles lacking the target page's permission see "Access restricted" after a drill link is clicked, and the drawer is already closed.
- **[O]** The event-marker triangles carry no labels or tooltips.
- **[O]** The chart canvas receives keyboard focus but offers no keyboard operation.
- **[I]** A portfolio with fewer than 170 daily returns, or a period that starts mid-year, is not handled.

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-126** *Lock official return* always shows "Official return blocked"; it never evaluates the checklist, has no maker-checker, role gate, confirmation or success path, and is never disabled.
- **DEF-127** Control bar *State* "PBOR current" (green) contradicts KPI *Official state* "Provisional" and the "1 pending" chip.
- **DEF-128** *Tracking error* is 6.42% ("Ex-post") on the page and 6.90% ("Annualised") in the explorer.
- **DEF-129** Brinson totals do not reconcile with the headline: segment totals 84 + 15 + 46 − 21 = 124 bps against active return 210 bps; allocation column sums to 17 bps against the bridge's +0.64%; selection column sums to 101 bps against +1.31%; segment weights sum to 61% (other segments omitted).
- **DEF-130** Explorer contributor totals (Consumer +0.96%) differ from the Brinson table (Consumer equities +84 bps); the explorer *Return quality* tab shows every control as Pass while the page shows one pending.
- **DEF-131** *Period* "01 Jan–28 Aug" differs from the chart series end date of 30 Aug.
- **DEF-132** Bridge bar widths are fixed percentages, not proportional to the values.
- **DEF-133** Range *1Y* equals *YTD*; range control affects only the chart.
- **DEF-134** Export is a fixed CSV literal, not derived from the displayed table; it omits the weight columns and offers no XLSX.
- **DEF-135** The Brinson "Cash" row has no colour class on *Total active* while the other rows are green.
- FR-PERF-002: Returns and attribution served from the API (`GET /api/v1/performance/returns`, `/attribution`) with range, portfolio and benchmark parameters — AC: every tile, table row and chart point equals the API response; Active return equals Portfolio − Benchmark; bridge components and Brinson rows sum to the active return within 0.01 percentage points.
- FR-PERF-003: Governance checklist driven by live validations (IBOR reconciliation, cash reconciliation, valuation sources, composite membership, fees and flows) — AC: the chip count equals the number of controls not done; the checklist and the explorer *Return quality* tab show the same states.
- FR-PERF-004: *Lock official return* as a checker action — AC: the call returns a refusal naming the open controls while any control is not done; a user who prepared the period receives 403; on success the period status is Official and the control-bar *State* and KPI *Official state* update.
- FR-PERF-005: Export attribution in CSV and XLSX from the displayed period — AC: file rows equal the table rows for the selected period including weights; an audit event is written.
- FR-PERF-006: Chart event markers (*Cash flow*, *Rebalance*, *IC decision*) labelled and clickable — AC: hovering shows the label and date; clicking opens the linked record.
- FR-PERF-007: Keyboard operation of the chart (arrow keys move the crosshair, Enter opens the drill drawer) — AC: all drawers reachable without a mouse.
- Q-40: Which user may lock an official return (new permission code or `reports.create`) and must the locker differ from the preparer? — default: `reports.create` plus maker ≠ checker, per existing Q-04.
- Q-41: Is factor exposure part of the scope of this page? — default: no; it is mentioned only in the superseded subtitle and is not built.
- Q-42: Which benchmark and composite apply per portfolio, and how often is the composite membership reviewed? — default: one approved composite per portfolio, reviewed monthly.

#### 5.A.9 Clients & Cash Accounts (`clients`, `clients.view`)

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Purpose | Find a client relationship, see what needs attention (KYC reviews, cash-account approvals, reconciliation breaks, closure blockers), manage the controlled bank / broker / custody cash accounts linked to each client, create client records and draft cash accounts, and drive the maker-checker lifecycle of a cash account. **[O]** |
| Access | Page gate `clients.view`; sidebar item carries `data-permission="clients.view"` and is hidden without it; opening the page by script without the permission shows the error toast "Access restricted" with text "<Role label> does not have permission to open this workspace." and the page does not open. Roles holding `clients.view`: investment_director, portfolio_manager, compliance, operations, client_services, auditor, system_admin. Roles without it: dealer, analyst, fund_accountant. In the role-focused sidebar (all roles) the *Clients* item is shown by default only for compliance and client_services; for every other role it is hidden until the user presses *All workspaces*. **[O]** None of the final-page buttons carries a permission attribute, so every role that can open the page sees every button enabled; permission is checked on click (toast) and, when bridged, by the API (see Actions). **[O]** |
| Prototype layer | Final UI is rendered by `v49-enhancements.js` (V49 simplified Clients & Cash Accounts), which replaces the page markup `14-page-clients.html` (original V56 register), the V43 relationship workspace (`v43-enhancements.js`) and the V47 simplification (`v47-enhancements.js`). Cash-account drawer, lifecycle function, balance-explanation drawer, Client second-layer page and Client 360 drawer come from `01-inline.js`; profile editor and client-layer branding from `03-v10-branding-kyc-js.js`; client-portal button from `05-v13-user-focus-js.js`. Data and write hooks: bridge `admin-20-clients.js`. **[O]** |
| Wiring status | **Bridged** when the user is signed in and the API answers: client list `GET /api/v1/clients`; cash-account list `GET /api/v1/cash-accounts`; create client `POST /api/v1/clients`; profile edit `PATCH /api/v1/clients/{id}`; create cash account `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts`; lifecycle `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts/{id}/{submit\|approve\|return\|suspend\|close}`. **Prototype** (hard-coded demo arrays, `localStorage`) when signed out or the API is unreachable, and for all KPI constants, the three relationship documents, the Client 360 drawer content, the Client second-layer static tabs, balances and reconciliation text. Balances (`posted`, `reserved`, `blocked`, `expected`, `available`, `withdrawable`) and `recon` are display strings held on the account record; they are not derived from the cash ledger. **[O]** |
| Entry points | (1) Sidebar item *Clients* (label *Clients & Accounts* in the original markup, shortened to *Clients* by the role-focus layer); on every sidebar click the page re-renders 80 ms later. (2) Onboarding second-layer page button *Client master*. (3) Client 360 drawer link *Cash registry →*. (4) Back arrow / breadcrumb of the Client second-layer page. (5) Server notification link `/#clients` (no URL routing exists, so the link opens the default page, not Clients). **[O]** |

##### Layout

The page is built in this order. For roughly 3.8 seconds after load the user may first see the superseded original and V43 layouts (see Edge cases); the list below is the final layout. **[O]**

1. Page head: eyebrow *CLIENTS · CASH · MANDATES*, heading *Clients & Cash Accounts*, lead text, and the action bar (*+ Client*, *+ Cash account*, *More* menu).
2. Summary strip with three KPI tiles: *Relationships*, *Available cash*, *Needs attention*.
3. Workbench card:
   1. Header row: tab bar with three tabs — *Clients* (default), *Cash accounts*, *Needs attention* — and one shared search box (placeholder "Search client, account or provider").
   2. Body area, content depends on the active tab:
      - Tab *Clients*: two panes. Left pane (32 % width, minimum 270 px) "Relationships" list. Right pane client detail: hero (avatar, name, identity line, buttons *Client 360*, *KYC*, *Report*); three metric tiles; "Next action" panel; two-column grid with "Cash accounts" section and "Relationship documents" section. The client detail has **no sub-tabs** in the final UI.
      - Tab *Cash accounts*: toolbar (state filter, *Export CSV*), three summary tiles, cash-account table.
      - Tab *Needs attention*: heading and list of attention items.
4. Overlays opened from the page: right-hand detail drawer (New client, New cash account, cash account, balance explanation, closure-blocked, profile editor, Client 360), report editor modal, controlled document preview modal. Second-level full page "Client" (section "Client second-layer page" below).

Session state of the page (kept in browser memory, reset on reload): active tab = *Clients*; active client = first client of the list; search text = empty; cash state filter = *All*. Re-entering the page through the sidebar keeps these values. **[O]**

Superseded layouts (traceability only, not in the final UI): original V56 page (four hard-coded KPI tiles *Active clients* 184 / "27 institutional · 157 private", *Approved cash accounts* 31 / "24 segregated · 4 omnibus · 3 hybrid", *Cash under control* US$ 11.86M / "Across bank, broker and custody accounts", *Account control exceptions* 2 / "1 mapping review · 1 closing blocker"; "Ownership invariant enforced" banner with link *View control rules →*; table "Client cash account registry"; table "Investor register" with a risk-rating select that was never wired; card "Account lifecycle control" with a five-step lane DRAFT, PENDING APPROVAL, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, CLOSING / CLOSED; buttons *Export registry*, *Client report*, *New cash account* gated by `clients.edit`); V43 workspace (five hard-coded KPIs *Active relationships* 184, *KYC action* 6, *Cash under control* US$ 11.86M, *Account exceptions* 2, *Pending approval* 1; tabs *Relationships*, *Cash accounts*, *Exceptions & approvals*; client sub-tabs *Overview*, *Accounts & cash*, *Compliance*, *Service & evidence*; account table with Posted / Reserved / Available columns and an "All controls / Needs attention / Clear" filter; USD posted, reserved, blocked and order-eligible meters); V47 renamed V43 tabs to *Clients*, *Needs attention* and sub-tabs to *Cash*, *Service*. **[O]**

After every successful prototype transition the page re-renders and the drawer closes. After a successful bridged transition the local record is merged with the server record, `matanho-cash-accounts-v43` is updated, the toast "Cash account <status text>" — "<id> · version <n>" is shown (status text = status lower-cased with the first underscore replaced by a space, for example "pending approval", "active", "draft") and the drawer is re-opened with the new state; the V49 lists and KPIs are **not** refreshed until the next tab click, search keystroke or sidebar navigation. **[O]**

**Drawer — Account closure blocked** **[O]** Control drawer, title "Account closure blocked", subtitle = account id. Section "Blocking conditions" lists the blockers: "Posted balance <ccy> <posted>" (posted ≠ 0), "Active reservations <ccy> <reserved>" (reserved ≠ 0), "Reconciliation: <recon>" (recon contains "Break" or "blocker"); text "Balances, reservations, suspense, open exceptions and unreconciled periods must clear before closure." Prototype only; the API performs no closure checks. In the seed every ACTIVE account has a non-zero posted balance and CCA-9902 has posted 5.00 plus "Close blocker", so closure is always blocked. A blocked balance alone is not a blocker. No buttons other than the drawer close control.
