##### States

- Empty: client list "No clients match your search."; linked accounts "No cash accounts yet. Create one when the banking or custody mandate is approved."; cash registry "No accounts in this view."; attention "No attention items in this view."; Client 360 "No controlled cash accounts are mapped to this client in the current demo data."; an empty client array (bridged and no clients) renders an empty detail pane. **[O]**
- Loading: none on this page. The legacy runtime waits up to 15 seconds for the bridge (client and cash-account loads) before it evaluates the prototype scripts; there is no skeleton or spinner. **[O]**
- Error: only toasts — "Permission denied", "Checker required", "Maker-checker conflict", "Access restricted", "Not saved" (API rejection, text = server message), "Image too large", "Logo could not be read", "Client name required". Silent: blank name/provider/identifier after trim, reject without a reason. **[O]**
- Disabled / read-only: no control on the final page is disabled; role restrictions are enforced by click-time toasts and by the API. The cash-account drawer is entirely read-only; there is no way to edit the mapping of a DRAFT account although the lifecycle text says the maker edits it. CLOSED is "read-only" only in toast wording. **[O]**
- Conditional: *Next action* panel tone and button label depend on KYC and reconciliation; client detail sections change with the number of linked accounts; ZWG text appears only when ZWG available > 0; Client 360 and second-layer panels switch text when risk is High; drawer buttons depend on account status. **[O]**
- Stale view: after a bridged lifecycle action and after navigation by any control other than the sidebar (for example the breadcrumb or *Cash registry →*), the page is not re-rendered, so lists and KPIs can be out of date until the next interaction. **[O]**
- Signed out / API unavailable: the demo arrays (seed data above) are shown and every write stays in the browser. **[O]**

##### Business rules & calculations

**Layer precedence.** Layers run in this order and the last layer that renders the page wins: original markup and `01-inline.js` renderers → V10 table with *Edit* button → V13 *Client portal preview* button → V43 (at +850 ms) → V47 copy simplification (+2800 ms) → V49 (+3800 ms, final; sets `renderClients` and `renderCashAccounts` to the V49 renderer and re-renders on every sidebar click). V50–V56 do not touch the page. The V43 wrapper around `cashAccountLifecycle` and the V43 restore of `matanho-cash-accounts-v43` stay active. **[O]**

**Cash-account lifecycle — state machine.** **[O]**

| Transition (UI action) | From | To | Prototype rule | Bridged / API rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Submit (*Submit for approval*) | DRAFT (prototype also SUSPENDED, CLOSED) | PENDING_APPROVAL | No check; version +1 | API accepts DRAFT only; permission `clients.edit` or `cash.approve`; no checker; sets `submitted_at`; notifies `cash.approve` holders; 409 "Cannot submit an account that is <STATUS>" otherwise |
| Approve (*Approve account*) | PENDING_APPROVAL | ACTIVE | Role in {compliance, operations, fund_accountant}; maker ≠ "T. Moyo" | `cash.approve`; maker ≠ approver when policy `cash_approval` is on (409 "The maker of this account cannot approve it"); sets checker and `approved_at`; may complete client activation |
| Return (*Reject*) | PENDING_APPROVAL | DRAFT | No check, no reason | `cash.approve`; reason required (400 "A reason is required to return an account"); UI prompt collects it |
| Suspend (*Suspend*) | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | No check | `cash.approve`; ≠ maker |
| Reactivate (no UI) | SUSPENDED | ACTIVE | Not implemented | `cash.approve`; ≠ maker |
| Close step 1 (*Start close*) | ACTIVE | prototype: CLOSED directly; API: CLOSING | Blockers: posted ≠ 0, reserved ≠ 0, recon contains "Break" or "blocker" | `cash.approve`; ≠ maker; no balance or reconciliation check |
| Close step 2 (*Run closure checklist*) | CLOSING | CLOSED | Same blockers as above | `cash.approve`; ≠ maker; no checks |

- Every API transition checks the optimistic `version`, writes an audit event `cash_account.<action>` with before/after status and reason, increments the version, and answers 409 "Cannot <action> an account that is <STATUS>" (code `invalid_transition`) when the source state does not allow it. **[O]**
- Roles able to approve, return, suspend, reactivate and close in the bridged system (holders of `cash.approve`): investment_director, compliance. operations and fund_accountant approve only in the prototype fallback. client_services and system_admin can create and submit but not approve. **[O]**
- Prototype closure-blocker test: posted and reserved are parsed to minor units (two decimals, thousands separators removed) and compared with zero. **[O]**
- Draft accounts "cannot post journals, reserve cash or commit statement imports" (rule text from the superseded V43 form); the Cash & Ledgers page does not enforce it for the account list. **[I]**
- BR-001 (maker ≠ checker) applies to approve, suspend, reactivate and close; BR-010 (AVAILABLE = POSTED − RESERVED − BLOCKED; WITHDRAWABLE = AVAILABLE − pending outflows − minimum balance) is the rule behind the displayed balances, but the page shows stored strings (for example CCA-1188: 882,114.00 − 0.00 − 25,000.00 = 857,114.00 available; CCA-1001: 10,000.00 − 3,000.00 = 7,000.00; CCA-9902 shows 0.00 available against 5.00 posted and 5.00 blocked). **[O]**

**Ownership invariant and control rules (text in the rules drawer of the superseded layers).** "No cash movement without legal entity, client/vehicle, mandate, portfolio, account, currency and internal ledger ownership." "No active duplicate provider + account identifier + currency mapping." "No create/mapping/suspend/reactivate/close without maker-checker." "No closure while balances, reservations, suspense, exceptions or unreconciled periods remain." None of these except the prototype closure blockers is enforced in the final UI. **[I]**

**Next-action rules** (client detail panel; first match wins). **[O]**

| Order | Condition | Tone | Title | Detail | Button |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | KYC matches /enhanced/i | risk | "Complete enhanced KYC review" | "New money activity should remain controlled until Compliance clears the evidence." | *Review* → Onboarding & KYC |
| 2 | KYC matches /review/i | warn | "Complete KYC refresh" | "Relationship review is due. Confirm identity, mandate and source-of-funds evidence." | *Review* |
| 3 | Any linked account with recon matching /break\|blocker/i (first one) | warn | "Resolve <id> cash exception" | "<provider> · <recon>" | *Open account* |
| 4 | Otherwise | none | "Relationship is current" | "No immediate KYC or cash-control action is blocking the relationship." | *No action* |

A client with KYC *Pending* matches neither rule 1 nor rule 2, so a new client is shown as "Relationship is current" although it is counted in *Needs attention*. **[O]**

**Identifier handling.** The identifier is stored encrypted and displayed only masked. The API offers `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts/{id}/reveal-identifier` (permission `cash.approve`, step-up authentication, audit event `cash_account.identifier_revealed`, FR-CLI-005); no control in the UI calls it. **[O]**

**Data model carried by the page.** **[O]**

- Client: `id` (reference `CL-#####`), `uuid` (bridged), `name`, `type`, `accounts` (count), `value` (display string), `ccy`, `kyc` (Pending, Current, Review due, Enhanced review), `risk` (Low, Medium, High), `mandate`, `owner`, `email`, `phone`, `registration`, `address`, `notes`, `logo` (prototype only), `portalEnabled`, `nextReviewDate`, `version`. Server default owner "Client Services", mandate "—", value "US$ 0.00M".
- Cash account: `id` (`CCA-####`), `uuid`, `legalEntity`, `client`, `clientId`, `mandate` (the client's mandate label), `portfolio` (stored in a metadata field, "—" when absent), `ownership` (SEGREGATED, OMNIBUS, HYBRID), `moneyClass` (CLIENT_MONEY), `type`, `provider`, `masked`, `currency`, `effective` (server shows the approval date, or "On approval"), `calendar` (default "Africa/Harare"), `tolerance` (default "<ccy>-CASH-STD"), `gl` (default "<ccy> cash control"), `status`, `posted`, `reserved`, `blocked`, `expected`, `available`, `withdrawable` (default "0.00"), `recon`, `statement` (default "No committed statement"), `maker` (default "Client Services"), `version`.

**Persistence.** Browser keys: `matanho-cash-accounts-v43` (the whole cash-account array; written by the create form, the lifecycle wrapper and the bridge; read and applied in place at +850 ms) and `matanho-client-profiles-v10` (editable profile fields and logo per client id; re-applied on load; deleted by the bridge on every successful live client load). **[O]** Server tables: clients, mandates, cash accounts (with encrypted identifier), audit events; the browser keys are to be retired (Appendix C). **[P]**

**API surface used by the page (all under the admin portal session, portal access `admin`).** **[O]**

| Method and path | Permission | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /api/v1/clients` (query `q`, `risk`, `kyc` supported, not used by the UI) | `clients.view` | Initial client list (sorted by name) |
| `POST /api/v1/clients` | `clients.edit` | Create client |
| `PATCH /api/v1/clients/{id}` (with `version`) | `clients.edit` | Save profile |
| `GET /api/v1/cash-accounts` | `cash.view` or `clients.view` | Initial cash-account list (sorted by id) |
| `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts` | `clients.edit` | Create draft account |
| `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts/{id}/{submit\|approve\|return\|suspend\|reactivate\|close}` | See state machine | Lifecycle; the UI action *Reject* maps to `return` |
| `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/360`, `GET`/`POST /api/v1/clients/{id}/mandates`, `POST /api/v1/cash-accounts/{id}/reveal-identifier` | `clients.view`, `clients.view`/`clients.edit`, `cash.approve` + step-up | Exist on the server; **not called** by the UI |

The bridge also asks for a step-up code (browser prompt "Confirm this action: enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.") when the API answers `step_up_required`. **[O]**

**Constants.** Relationships tile 184; client id floor 433; cash id floor 1000; owner list L. Chuma, P. Ncube, R. Marufu, S. Moyo; portfolio list of five names; legal entity "Matanho Managed Funds"; effective date "01 Sep 2026"; calendar "Africa/Harare"; tolerance "USD-CASH-STD" / "ZWG-CASH-STD"; default maker text "Client Services"; hard-coded maker name "T. Moyo"; prototype approver roles compliance, operations, fund_accountant; prototype creator roles `clients.edit` or operations, compliance, system_admin; export file name date 2026-09-01; document dates 28 Aug 2026, 31 Aug 2026, 26 Aug 2026; logo limit 600,000 bytes; bridge wait 15 s. **[O]**

##### Edge cases

- Flash of superseded layouts: for about 3.8 seconds after load the original markup, then the V43 workspace and V47 copy, may be visible before the V49 page replaces them. **[O]**
- Client id collision: every prototype-created client in a session receives `CL-00434` (see DEFECT); the second client created gets the same id as the first, and selection and lookups use the first match. **[O]**
- Cash-account id collision: every prototype-created account receives `CCA-1001`, the id of the seeded Horizon custody account; opening or acting on that id always affects the seeded account. **[O]**
- Bridged create: the prototype submit is replayed after the API call, so the local copy (with the colliding prototype id) stays in the array next to the server record; the alignment step cannot find a distinct local copy for a client, and for an account it copies the server record onto the local draft so two entries share the server id until reload. **[O]**
- Orphans: prototype-created clients vanish on reload while cash accounts saved in `matanho-cash-accounts-v43` remain linked to ids that no longer exist. **[O]**
- Omnibus account `CCA-7710` (client id `POOL-01`) counts in the USD KPI and the cash tab but is not linked to any client detail. **[O]**
- *Submit for approval* is shown on SUSPENDED and CLOSED accounts; the API rejects it with 409. No *Reactivate* control exists. **[O]**
- Prototype closure goes ACTIVE → CLOSED directly; the API requires two close calls (ACTIVE → CLOSING → CLOSED) and checks nothing. **[O]**
- Bridged lifecycle actions run no prototype role checks; prototype approver roles operations and fund_accountant receive "Not saved" because they lack `cash.approve`. **[O]**
- A bridged lifecycle result does not refresh the V49 page; a bridged account unknown to the server (for example a prototype draft) falls back to the prototype logic. **[O]**
- Reject with an empty or cancelled reason prompt does nothing and shows no message. **[O]**
- *More* menu stays open after choosing an item. **[O]**
- The cash-tab summary tiles are styled for `div` elements but rendered as `article`, so they lack the bordered card style. **[O]**
- Export ignores the search text and the state filter. **[O]**
- Client 360 subtitle displays literal "&middot;". **[O]**
- *Client portal* opens a non-existent file. **[O]**
- Profile logos are lost on reload in bridged mode (the logo is not sent to the API and the local profile store is cleared on load). **[O]**
- Global search lists matching clients, but the result rows have no click handler. **[O]**
- The server notification link `/#clients` opens the default page because the portal has no URL routing. **[O]**
- No automatic KYC transition exists: `Review due` is a manually set value, although the server stores `nextReviewDate`. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-138** V49 numeric parsing keeps the hyphen, so `n("CL-00418")` = −418 and every new client id is computed as `CL-00434` (maximum of existing ids and 433, plus 1); duplicates occur from the second creation. V43 parsed correctly. Production ids come only from the server sequence.
- **DEF-139** V49 `n("CCA-1001")` = −1001, so every new prototype cash account is `CCA-1001`, colliding with the seeded account.
- **DEF-140** the bridged create flow leaves duplicate local rows (client `CL-00434` next to the server client; two account entries sharing the server id) until reload.
- **DEF-141** bridged lifecycle result does not re-render the V49 lists and KPIs.
- **DEF-142** a client with KYC *Pending* is shown as "Relationship is current" in the next-action panel while counted in *Needs attention*.
- **DEF-143** the account status is not shown in the client detail account rows; DRAFT and PENDING_APPROVAL accounts display a green reconciliation badge.
- **DEF-144** SUSPENDED and CLOSED accounts offer *Submit for approval* (409 from the API); no *Reactivate* control although the server supports it.
- **DEF-145** prototype `cashAccountLifecycle` has no permission checks on submit, reject, suspend, close, and the maker-checker test compares with the hard-coded name "T. Moyo"; new drafts carry the maker text "Client Services", so the test never fires.
- **DEF-146** the cash state filter lacks SUSPENDED and CLOSED; the export ignores filters and its toast says "current controlled cash-account view".
- **DEF-147** Client 360 subtitle shows "&middot;" literally; *Client portal* link targets a missing `client-portal.html`; profile editor logo not persisted when bridged; created clients not persisted in prototype mode.
- **DEF-148** profile editor lets a `clients.edit` user set the KYC state directly (including *Current*), bypassing the KYC workflow, and relationship owner is free text.
- **DEF-149** the cash-summary tiles use the wrong element selector in the stylesheet (no card style).
- **DEF-150** *Relationships* KPI is a constant 184 and the Client 360 / second-layer metrics (net flows, YTD performance, headroom, pending withdrawal, secure messages) are constants.
- FR-CLI-008: The Relationships KPI shows the real count of non-archived clients, and the *Needs attention* KPI uses the same rule as the *Needs attention* tab — AC: with 6 clients and 2 not Current the tile equals the number of attention items listed in the tab; the count matches the API total.
- FR-CLI-009: Client creation assigns the reference only on the server (`CL-#####`) and the UI shows the server record once, without a local duplicate — AC: creating two clients in one session yields two distinct references and two rows.
- FR-CLI-010: Cash-account creation assigns the reference only on the server (`CCA-####`) and refuses a second active or draft account with the same provider, identifier and currency — AC: duplicate request returns 409 and the form shows the message.
- FR-CLI-011: The cash-account drawer offers *Reactivate* for SUSPENDED accounts to `cash.approve` holders (≠ maker) and offers *Submit for approval* only for DRAFT — AC: SUSPENDED account shows *Reactivate*; no submit control for SUSPENDED/CLOSED.
- FR-CLI-012: The client detail account rows and the registry show the account state badge next to the reconciliation text — AC: a DRAFT account shows "DRAFT" and an amber badge.
- FR-CLI-013: The cash-account list supports state filters for SUSPENDED and CLOSED and the CSV export honours the active search and state filter — AC: exporting with filter ACTIVE yields only ACTIVE rows; the file name carries the export date.
- FR-CLI-014: The cash-account list refreshes after any lifecycle action and after returning to the page — AC: after *Approve account* the row shows ACTIVE without any further click.
- FR-CLI-015: The relationship documents list reads the client's documents from `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/360` (Document Vault) and previews the stored document — AC: a document uploaded in the Vault for the client appears with its real date; generated placeholders are not shown.
- FR-CLI-016: The Client second layer and Client 360 read live data (mandates, KYC cases, requests, portal users, pending invitations) from `GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/360` and drop the hard-coded constants — AC: no constant metric remains; every value traces to a record.
- FR-CLI-017: The relationship list gains a KYC / risk filter and server-side `q` search — AC: filter "Enhanced review" lists only those clients.
- FR-CLI-018: The client profile editor does not change KYC state; KYC state changes only through the KYC case workflow and relationship owner is chosen from staff users — AC: no KYC select in the editor; owner is a user reference.
- FR-CLI-019: The cash-account create form includes ownership model (SEGREGATED, OMNIBUS, HYBRID), portfolio list limited to the client's portfolios, and a reveal control for the identifier for `cash.approve` holders with step-up — AC: reveal writes the audit event `cash_account.identifier_revealed`.
- FR-CLI-020: A "Client portal" action opens the investor portal for the client on the correct host or is removed — AC: the link never opens a not-found page.
- FR-CLI-021: Sidebar and notification links open the Clients page directly (URL routing, `/#clients`) — AC: following the notification link lands on Clients.
- BR-033: Cash-account closure requires zero posted balance, no active reservations, no open reconciliation break and no suspense on the account, enforced by the server for the CLOSING → CLOSED step — AC: closing an account with posted 5.00 returns 409 with the blocker list.
- BR-034: A cash account in DRAFT or PENDING_APPROVAL cannot post journals, reserve cash or commit statement imports — AC: such calls return 409.
- BR-035: The cash-account maker is the signed-in user (not a fixed text) and the SoD check compares user ids — AC: a maker cannot approve, suspend, reactivate or close their own account; the drawer shows the maker's name.
- Q-43: Should operations and fund_accountant (prototype approvers) hold `cash.approve`, or is approval limited to investment_director and compliance as seeded? — default: seed stays (investment_director, compliance); prototype approver list is dropped.
- Q-44: Should creating a cash account require only `clients.edit` (client_services, compliance, system_admin) or also operations? — default: `clients.edit` only.
- Q-45: Is the full set of account types limited to CLIENT_BANK, CUSTODY_CASH, BROKER_SETTLEMENT, SUSPENSE, or must FX_SETTLEMENT, INCOME_RECEIPT and FEE_COLLECTION (present in the V43 form and original V56 form) remain? — default: all seven are allowed by the API; the form offers the three used by V49 plus SUSPENSE.
- Q-46: Is the omnibus pool account (`POOL-01`) linked to a vehicle record instead of a client? — default: yes, a client-type "vehicle" record.
- Q-47: Does the weekly/monthly reporting cadence workspace of V61 (see below) replace or extend the V49 page? — default: extend as a tab after the cash-account lifecycle is complete.

- **Empty state [O]:** "No service work matches this view." (class `v33-empty`).

**Table — Live task derivation (bridge `buildTasks`)** **[O]**

| Source (endpoint) | Inclusion rule | Kind | Title | Detail | Due | Owner | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Service requests (`GET /api/v1/service-requests`) | `status` is not `Closed` | Request | "<client> · <title>" | "<type> · <status>" plus " · time sensitive" when priority is `Time sensitive` | SLA text (below) | request owner | `critical` when breached; `good` when status is `Waiting on you`; otherwise `warn` |
| Capital events (`GET /api/v1/capital-events`), status `Draft` | always | Money | "Approve <type lower-case> · <id>" | "<client> · <investment> · <amount>" | event due date | "Investor Ops" | warn |
| status `Approved` | always | Money | "Publish notice · <id>" | same | same | same | warn |
| status `Processing` | always | Money | "Match funding evidence · <id>" | same | same | same | critical |
| status `Due` | always | Money | "Awaiting investor funding · <id>" | same | same | same | good |
| status `Expected` | always | Money | "Release payment · <id>" for Distribution and Withdrawal; "Expected receipt · <id>" otherwise | same | same | same | warn |
| status `Funded`, `Paid` or any other | excluded | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| Documents (`GET /api/v1/documents`; only loaded when the user has `documents.view`), status `In review` | always | Publication | "Approve <name>" | "<label> · <client or related> · v<currentVersion>" | document date | document owner | warn |
| Documents, status `Approved`, classification `Client` or `Public`, no publications | always | Publication | "Publish <name>" | "<label> · <client or related> · approved" | document date | document owner | warn |
| Documents, each signature request with status `Pending` (task id "<documentId>:<clientId>") | always | Signature | "Awaiting signature · <name>" | "<clientId> · authorised signatory required" | document date | document owner | warn |
| Message threads (`GET /api/v1/message-threads`), unread count greater than 0 | always | Request | "Reply to <client> · <title>" | "Secure portal message · <n> unread" | last activity day | thread owner | warn |

- **Amount format [O]:** "<currency, default USD> <amount in en-US grouping, no decimals>", for example "USD 1,860,000".
- **SLA text [O]:** with no `slaDueAt` show the opened text. Otherwise `h = round((slaDueAt − now) / 3,600,000)`; `h < 0` gives "SLA breached"; `h < 24` gives "SLA <h>h"; otherwise "SLA <round(h/24)>d".
- **Breach flag [O]:** computed by the server as `slaDueAt` set, status not `Closed` and `slaDueAt` earlier than now.
- **Kind coverage [O]:** live mode never produces kind `KYC`, so the chip *KYC / access* is always empty when live; message-thread tasks are classed `Request`.

- `portal` is "Active" when the client has `portalEnabled`, otherwise "Not invited".
- `next` is the title of the first open (not `Closed`) service request of the client; otherwise "No open requests" when KYC is `Current`; otherwise "KYC " plus the lower-cased KYC state (for example "KYC pending", "KYC review due", "KYC enhanced review").

##### Modals & drawers

**Common dialog behaviour** **[O]**
- Both the V34 `openModal` and the bridge `mx.modal` render into `#v34Modal` / `#v34ModalBackdrop`. Header has a kicker, h2, paragraph and a close button ("×" in V34, "x" in the bridge). Clicking the backdrop closes the dialog. There is no Escape-key handler.
- `wide: true` sets the maximum width to 1180 px.
- The bridge dialog footer holds *Close* plus one button per action. While an action runs its button is disabled. The dialog closes when the action resolves to anything other than `false`. A rejected action shows the toast "Not saved" with the server message (kind error), keeps the dialog open and re-enables the button.
- Server validation errors surface as "Validation failed".
- Version conflicts surface as "This record was changed by someone else. Reload and try again."
- **Step-up [O]:** endpoints guarded by step-up return 401 `step_up_required` when the last MFA verification is older than 5 minutes. The bridge then calls `window.prompt` with "Confirm this action: enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app." and `POST /api/auth/mfa/step-up`. Cancelling shows "Confirmation cancelled" through the "Not saved" toast. A user without an enrolled factor passes step-up unless policy `mfa_required` is on, in which case the error is "Set up two-factor authentication to continue".

- **Allocation rule [O]:** holders are snapshot investments whose name contains the vehicle string in `Published` snapshots (one per client, because publishing supersedes the previous snapshot). Weight = `unfunded` for a Capital call, otherwise `commitment`; weights must be above 0. With no holders the error is "No investor holds an open commitment in <vehicle>". Share = `round(amount × weight / total, 2 decimals)`; the last holder receives the remainder so the shares sum exactly to the amount. One `Draft` notice per client is created (reference `CAP-####` starting at 1001) with the user as maker. Audit `capital.created` per notice; users with `cash.approve` are notified "Approve <type> · <vehicle>" with body "<n> investor notices awaiting checker approval". Response `{refs, investors}`.
- **Single-client notice [I]:** `POST /api/v1/capital-events` (client id, investment, type, amount, currency 3 characters, due, purpose, breakdown lines that must sum to the amount, bank text) exists but is not reachable from the UI. Its error is "Breakdown lines must add up to the notice amount".

##### States

- Empty: **[O]** Task list shows "No service work matches this view." when the filter and search leave no task. The relationship list renders an empty container with no message (**DEF-155** no empty state). In live mode, capital events in `Funded` or `Paid` and closed requests never appear in the queue.
- Loading: **[O]** No spinner or skeleton. Prototype scripts wait for the bridge loader for at most 15 s, then continue with demo data. The superseded V14 page is visible for about 0.9 s until V34 replaces it.
- Error: **[O]** Any dialog action failure shows the toast "Not saved" with the server message (kind error); the dialog stays open and the button re-enables. If any bridge loader request rejects, the whole loader fails (logged to the console) and the page falls back to demo data without a banner.
- Disabled / read-only: **[O]** A dialog action button is disabled only while its request is in flight (the bridge also ignores a second click while busy). Users lacking the permission do not see the action button at all; the dialog shows only *Close* plus download buttons. The header buttons *New secure message*, *+ Service request*, *Investor portal* and the quick action *Create capital call / distribution* are never disabled by permission (DEFECT).
- Conditional: **[O]**
  - Demo mode (signed out, API unreachable or loader failure): V34 demo arrays, the generic service-task modal, creates only close the dialog (toast for the request, none for the capital event), nothing is persisted.
  - Partial live (`mx.live` is true but the investor-services loader failed): task clicks open the demo modal, but *Create request* is still intercepted and fails with "Choose an investor that exists in the client master" because the client list is empty.
  - The *KYC / access* chip is always empty when live.
  - The *Publish to client* and *Return reason* fields appear only for `documents.edit` holders in the matching document status.
  - Role focus navigation (V16): the sidebar item is visible by default only for investment_director, operations and client_services; other page-access roles see it after choosing *All workspaces*.

##### Business rules & calculations

- **Page copy and layering [O]:** the V34 service desk is the final UI; the V14 workbench table, capital queue, publication queue, portal-access card, communications card, service-health card and calendar card are not displayed.
- **Persistence [O]:** no `localStorage` key is used by this page. State lives in memory or in the API.
- **Bridge loader [O]:** registered for permission `clients.view`; it runs in parallel `GET /api/v1/service-requests`, `GET /api/v1/capital-events`, `GET /api/v1/documents` (only with `documents.view`), `GET /api/v1/message-threads`, `GET /api/v1/clients`. After any mutation `mx.refreshServices()` refetches all of them, replaces the arrays in place and re-clicks the active chip. Only the task list re-renders.
- **State machine — Capital event [O]:**
  - `Draft` → `Approved`: approve; `cash.approve`, MFA step-up, approver is not the maker (policy `cash_approval`, default on).
  - `Approved` → `Due` (Capital call) or `Expected` (Distribution, Contribution, Withdrawal): publish; `clients.edit` or `cash.approve`; investor notified and emailed.
  - `Due`, `Expected` → `Processing`: the investor uploads proof of payment in the investor portal (capital calls and contributions only; Investor Admin or Finance roles only).
  - `Due`, `Expected`, `Processing` → `Funded` (incoming: Capital call, Contribution) or `Paid` (outgoing: Distribution, Withdrawal): settle; `cash.approve` or `cash.journal.approve`, MFA step-up; for incoming events the matcher must differ from the user who submitted the evidence.
  - Queue labels by status: `Draft` "Approve …" (warn), `Approved` "Publish notice" (warn), `Processing` "Match funding evidence" (critical), `Due` "Awaiting investor funding" (good), `Expected` "Release payment" or "Expected receipt" (warn). `Funded` and `Paid` leave the queue.
  - Investors see only published events in `Expected`, `Due`, `Processing`, `Funded`, `Paid`.
  - No cancel or withdraw transition exists **[I]**.
- **State machine — Service request [O]:** `Open`, `In progress`, `Waiting on you` (waiting on the client), `Closed`. The UI offers a free select with no transition rules. `Closed` forces progress 100 and removes the request from the queue. A breach is computed, not a state.
- **State machine — Document as used on this page [O]:** `Draft` → `In review` (submit, Vault page) → `Approved` (approve) → `Published` (publish to client). `In review` or `Approved` → `Draft` (return). Only classifications `Client` and `Public` may be published to investors.
- **State machine — Signature request [O]:** `Pending` until signed in the investor portal; each pending request yields an "Awaiting signature" task.
- **State machine — Secure thread [O]:** unread count per staff user; opening the thread marks it read; no status field.
- **State machine — Portal access [I]:** the superseded V14 drawer showed Active, Invited, Locked and Blocked; the backend has members (Active or Disabled) and pending invitations (Invited, expiry date). Investor roles available on invitation: admin, investment, finance, auditor; scope default "all".
- **Maker-checker [O]:** capital notice approval and document approval require a different person than the maker; cash matching requires a different person than the evidence submitter.
- **SLA defaults [O]:** 48 hours for *Normal* requests, 8 hours for *Time sensitive* requests when no due date is given; breach when the due time is earlier than now and the request is not `Closed`; SLA text formula in *Tables*.
- **Event type mapping [O]:** Capital call → Capital call; Distribution → Distribution; Subscription → Contribution; Redemption → Withdrawal. Incoming types: Capital call, Contribution. Outgoing types: Distribution, Withdrawal.
- **Allocation [O]:** pro-rata by unfunded commitment for calls and by commitment for all other events; 2-decimal rounding with the remainder on the last investor; calculation described under *Create capital event*.
- **Step-up window [O]:** 5 minutes.
- **Relationship next obligation [O]:** first open request, otherwise "No open requests" when KYC is Current, otherwise "KYC <state lower-case>".
- **Notifications and audit [O]:** every mutating endpoint writes an audit record (`capital.created`, `capital.approved`, `capital.published`, `capital.matched` or `capital.paid`, `service_request.created`, `service_request.updated`, `document.*`, `message.sent`) and queues notifications through the outbox.
- BR-036: A capital notice, once `Funded` or `Paid`, must stay visible to staff in a capital history list with its evidence and approver names.
- BR-037: KPI tiles must be calculated from the same queue data the page lists, so that each tile count equals the number of rows it summarises.

##### Edge cases

- **[O]** Task search and relationship search share one input; typing re-renders both lists, while the chips affect tasks only.
- **[O]** Opening a message thread marks it read immediately, but its task stays in the queue until the next refresh.
- **[O]** The *Publish to client* select has no blank option; for a document with no client the first client alphabetically is preselected and receives the publication unless changed.
- **[O]** A return reason of one or two characters passes the UI but fails server validation (3 to 1000 characters).
- **[O]** Priority *High* and *Urgent* are both stored as "Time sensitive".
- **[O]** The notice date entered in *Create capital event* is not sent to the server.
- **[O]** The vehicle match is a substring match, so "Growth Fund I" also matches holdings named "Growth Fund II".
- **[O]** The relationship list is not re-rendered by `mx.refreshServices()` (only the task list is).
- **[O]** `Open proof of payment` offers only the newest evidence file.
- **[O]** V34 resets the page class to `page v33-workspace`; if the user is already on this page at that moment, the `active` class can be dropped until the next navigation **[I]** (timing-dependent).
- **[O]** Task ids for signatures are composite ("<documentId>:<clientId>"), so one document with several pending signatories yields several tasks that open the same document dialog.

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-156** the six KPI tiles and the sidebar badge "5" are hard-coded and contradict live data.
- **DEF-157** the *KYC / access* chip is always empty in live mode; no KYC or portal-access task source exists in the bridge.
- **DEF-158** *New secure message* does not persist (the API exists), and the demo *Save service update* does not persist.
- **DEF-159** the *Investor portal* button opens the relative address `client-portal.html`, which is not served by the Next.js admin portal (the public folder holds only `assets` and `legacy`); it probably returns 404. The bridge helper for sibling-portal URLs exists but is not used.
- **DEF-160** the capital event *Notice date* is ignored; the vehicle list is hard-coded; vehicle matching is by substring.
- **DEF-161** *Publish to client* preselects the first client when the document has none.
- **DEF-162** the Investor 360 tabs are inert; *Latest approved statement* and *Open service requests* are hard-coded; *KYC current* is always "Yes" when live; *Bank instructions verified* is always "Yes".
- **DEF-163** the relationship list does not re-render after a refresh; it has no empty state.
- **DEF-164** *+ Service request*, *Create capital call / distribution* and *New secure message* have no UI permission gating; unauthorised roles see a 403 "Not saved" toast.
- **DEF-165** capital notice *publish* has no optimistic-lock check and no step-up on the server.
- **DEF-166** every request save records an "Assigned" event and re-assigns the request to the saving user.
- **DEF-167** opening a thread does not remove its task until the next refresh.
- **DEF-168** no Escape-key handler for the dialog.
- FR-INV-011: The page shall provide a portal-access management panel (list members and pending invitations per client; invite with email, name, role admin, investment, finance or auditor, and scope; revoke) for users with `clients.edit` — AC: inviting creates a pending invitation visible in the list; revoking removes access and the user can no longer sign in to that client's data; each action is audited.
- FR-INV-012: The capital event form shall let the maker choose the vehicle from the private-investment register and show the calculated per-investor allocation before the drafts are created — AC: preview rows sum exactly to the gross amount; the preview shows an error when no investor holds an open commitment.
- FR-INV-013: The notice date and an optional notice document shall be stored on every capital event — AC: the investor portal shows the notice date and can download the attached notice.
- FR-INV-014: The service desk KPI tiles shall be computed from live data — AC: each tile equals the count or amount of the rows it summarises, and the sidebar badge equals the count of open work items for the signed-in role.
- FR-INV-015: *New secure message* shall create a thread through `POST /api/v1/message-threads` and show "Message sent" — AC: the thread appears in the investor portal messages with an unread badge and in the staff queue after the investor replies.
- FR-INV-016: The workspace shall include a capital-event list with status filter and history (including `Funded` and `Paid`) — AC: a settled notice remains listed with approver, matcher and evidence file.
- FR-INV-017: Action buttons shall be hidden or disabled when the user lacks the required permission, with a tooltip stating the permission — AC: a user without `clients.edit` does not see *+ Service request*, or sees it disabled with a tooltip.
- FR-INV-018: The Investor portal button shall open the investor portal at the configured portal URL — AC: the button opens a working login page in a new tab in every environment.
- Q-48: Should *Investment director* and *Portfolio manager* be able to create service requests and reply to messages (they hold `clients.view` only)? — default: no; keep `clients.edit` for creation and replies.
- Q-49: Is Investor Services to be split into the V61 sub-tabs (*Service queue*, *Capital*, *Publications*) in the production build? — default: yes, following V61.
- Q-50: Should publishing a document to several clients at once be supported from this page? — default: yes, multi-select audience; the API already accepts a list of client ids.

##### Tables

**Case queue (card list)** — not a `<table>`; each card has the following content.

| Column / field | Format | Sortable | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | Bold text | No | Legal name |
| Reference line | "<id> · <type> · <owner>" | No | id = application ref `ONB-######` (live) or seed `KYC-24xx`; owner may be blank for public submissions (renders as empty) |
| Chip | Text + colour | No | Text: "Digital" if digital, else "Ready" if status Ready, else the risk value. Colour: green Ready, red risk High, blue digital, amber otherwise. **In live mode every case is digital, so the chip always reads "Digital" and risk is not visible in the queue** |
| Progress bar | Width = readiness % | No | Amber when readiness < 70 |
| Footer | "<readiness>% ready · <n> blocker(s) · <next>" | No | "blocker" singular when exactly 1 |

- **Sort**: none. Order = server `createdAt` descending (live, max 200), then seed cases in declaration order (offline only). **[O]**
- **Search** (`Search client, reference or owner`): case-insensitive substring of "<name> <id> <owner> <type>"; input not trimmed; a null owner is searched as the text "null". Re-renders the queue only. **[O]**
- **Filter** (select, default *Needs action*): *Needs action* = status ≠ Ready; *All cases*; *Ready* = status = Ready; *High risk* = risk = High; *Digital submissions* = digital flag. On change both queue and detail re-render. **[O]**
- **Row click**: selects the case, resets tab to *Profile*, re-renders queue and detail. **[O]**
- **Selection rules**: initial selection id "KYC-2418" (offline seed); if the selected case is absent from the case set the first case is selected; if absent from the filtered list and the list is non-empty the first filtered case is selected; if the filtered list is empty the detail pane keeps the previous case. **[O]**
- **Row actions / pagination**: none. **[O]**
- **Status → badge colour** (case status chip): Ready green; risk High red; otherwise amber. **[O]**

Digital cases only: nested card kicker *APPLICANT-SUPPLIED DATA*, h2 *Digital application summary* with rows *Registration / ID reference* (value or "—"); *Contact* (sub "<email> · <phone>", each "—" if blank; right side country or "—"); *Expected investment* ("US$ " + number, grouping, max 2 decimals, always labelled US$ regardless of base currency); *Purpose* (sub purpose or "Not provided"; right side "Applicant"). Right aside kicker *CASE TIMELINE*, h2 *Latest activity*: first 6 timeline entries; empty: "No timeline events yet." Not shown anywhere: channel, SLA state/due, source of funds or wealth text, tax data, blocker reasons, AI exceptions. Wiring: Bridged `GET /api/v1/kyc/cases/legacy`.

**Tab — Parties & UBOs** [O]. Card (8/12 width) kicker *PARTIES & OWNERSHIP*, h2 *Applicant, controllers and beneficial owners*, button *+ Party*, parties table (above). Aside (4/12) kicker *OWNERSHIP CONTROL*, h2 = ownership state ("Complete", "Captured", "Pending", "Review"); rows *Ownership chain* (sub "Declared economic interests"; value = ownership state), *Controllers* (sub "Board / signatory authority"; value = number of parties **including the applicant**), *Evidence link* (value "Available" if any evidence label matches "ownership" or "share" (case-insensitive), else "Required"). Wiring: Bridged (owners from application), Prototype (derived values).

**Tab — Screening** [O]. Card (8/12) kicker *KYC / AML*, h2 *Identity and financial-crime controls*, button *Refresh screening*; four decision cards: *Identity* (value = identity text; sub "Documents + registry / person checks"); *Sanctions* (value "Clear" when screening is "Clear", otherwise "Review" — including "Queued"; sub "Provider result retained"); *PEP* (value "Human review" when screening text contains "PEP", else "No blocking match"; sub "Risk-based disposition"); *Source of funds / wealth* (value = funds text; sub "Economic rationale + supporting evidence"). Aside (4/12) kicker *SCREENING RUN*, h2 = screening run reference; rows *Provider* "Approved provider" (static); *Last run* (value = last-run time, "Not run" if none; live format `toLocaleString('en-GB')`); *Final authority* "Human" (static). Wiring: Bridged for data; button Bridged (see Actions).

**Tab — Evidence & previews** [O]. Card head kicker *SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS*, h2 *Applicant evidence with in-place preview*, paragraph "Click Preview to inspect the exact applicant upload when V35 evidence storage is available, or a controlled prototype representation for seeded demo records.", button *Request evidence* (full width on mobile). Evidence cards as in Tables. Buttons per card: *Preview* (disabled when state is "Missing"); *Request* (state Missing) or *Ask question* (any other state). Wiring: Prototype for Preview and Request (see Actions).

**Tab — Suitability & mandate** [O], presentational only. Card (7/12) kicker *SUITABILITY & APPROPRIATENESS*, h2 *Investment relationship profile* with six unbound selects (see Inputs). Aside (5/12) kicker *DIGITISED MANDATE*, h2 = mandate text; static rows *Single issuer* (sub "Hard limit") "10%"; *Equities* (sub "Approved band") "30–65%"; *Private assets* (sub "Maximum") "20%"; *Offshore* (sub "Permission") "Within mandate" — identical for every case. Wiring: Prototype.

**Tab — Decision & audit** [O]. Card (7/12) kicker *HUMAN DECISION*, h2 *Approve, request information or decline*, paragraph "Automation can package evidence and screening; it cannot make the final KYC decision."; rationale textarea; buttons *Request information*, *Decline*, *Approve & activate*. Aside (5/12) kicker *DECISION EVIDENCE*, h2 *Approval gates*; rows *Screening* (sub = run reference; value = screening text), *Evidence completeness* (value = evidence %), *Mandate* (value = mandate text), *Current decision* (value "Approved", "Declined", "Enhanced review" or "Pending"). The tab contains **no audit trail** despite its name (the timeline is on *Profile*). Wiring: Bridged.

##### States

- **Empty**: queue with no matching case shows "No onboarding cases match this view." [O]. With zero cases in total the detail pane stays blank (no empty-detail message) [O]. Empty timeline: "No timeline events yet." [O]. Missing evidence file: *Preview* disabled, state chip "Missing" (red) [O].
- **Loading**: no spinner or skeleton. The page is built about 1.35 s after legacy boot from data already placed in `localStorage["matanho-onboarding-v10"]` by the bridge (bridge timeout 15 s). Until the simplification layer runs (about 3 s after boot) the pre-simplification header, hidden KPI strip and three extra buttons can flash. [O]
- **Error**: every bridged failure shows the red toast "Not saved" / "<server message>". Examples: 403 "Only Compliance can record a KYC decision"; 409 "The person who prepared this case cannot also decide it"; 409 approval blocked with the blockers joined by "; "; 409 "Cannot approve a case in <stage>"; 409 "Cannot reject a case in <stage>"; 409 "Only approved cases can be activated"; 409 "High-risk case: enhanced review approval is required before activation"; 409 "Source of funds has not been approved"; 409 "This record was changed by someone else. Reload and try again."; "This demo case is not stored on the server."; "Write the message first."; "Confirmation cancelled". If the initial case load fails the loader only logs a console warning and the page shows whatever is in localStorage. [O]
- **Disabled / read-only**: *Preview* disabled for Missing evidence; *Approve & activate* disabled while blockers > 0. There is no read-only mode for users without `onboarding.manage` (all controls visible; server rejects when live). [O]
- **Conditional**: *APPLICANT-SUPPLIED DATA* card and the " · DIGITAL APPLICATION" kicker suffix only for digital cases; *Request* vs *Ask question* by evidence state; *Controls & workflow* collapsed by default; summary tile *Needs review* active by default. [O]
- **Offline / prototype mode** (API unreachable or signed out): all actions are local and in-memory; the 4 seed cases (below) are shown in addition to any stored records; decline is impossible; screening refresh converts "Not run"/"Queued" to "Clear". [O]

##### Business rules & calculations

- **Operating mode**: live when the bridge boot succeeded (`mx.live`) and the user holds `onboarding.view`; the loader fetches `GET /api/v1/kyc/cases/legacy` (max 200 cases, newest first) before prototype scripts run and mirrors it into `localStorage["matanho-onboarding-v10"]`. Seed cases are shown only when not live. Bridge intercepts act only when live and the stored list is an array. [O]
- **Server → UI mapping (live)**: id = application ref `ONB-######` (counter starts 104830); name = legal name or "Digital applicant"; type = applicant type; risk = Pending / Low / Medium / High; owner = case owner name (blank for public submissions); readiness = 100 for Approved/Activation/Active, 0 for Rejected, otherwise max(18, min(95, round(received required slots ÷ required slots × 60 + (screening exists ? 20 : 0) + (no blockers ? 15 : 0)))); status = "Declined" if Rejected, else "Action" if any blocker, else "Ready"; blockers count = number of blockers when stage is ComplianceReview or Approved, otherwise max(1, number of blockers); next action text per stage (below); screening = latest run summary; screening run ref "SCR-<digits of case ref>-<last 4 digits of epoch ms>"; decision = "Approved", "Declined", "Enhanced review" or "Pending"; mandate = "Shell created" when a client exists else "Not started"; identity = "Received" when slot doc1 has a file else "Queued"; funds = "Approved" if funds approved, "Under review" if slot doc3 has a file, else "Queued"; ownership (client-side) = "Captured" if the applicant declared ≥ 1 beneficial owner else "Pending"; stage index = Submitted 0, ClientAction 2, Screening 3, EnhancedReview 3, ComplianceReview 4, Approved/Rejected/Activation/Active 6. [O]
- **Next-action text per stage**: Submitted/Screening "Automated document and AML pre-screening before human review."; ComplianceReview = first blocker, else "Compliance decision with recorded rationale."; ClientAction "Applicant to upload the requested evidence."; EnhancedReview "Complete enhanced due diligence, then return to compliance review."; Approved "Activate: create client, mandate shell, draft cash account and investor invitation."; Activation "Cash account approval and investor invitation acceptance."; Active "Relationship live. Periodic review scheduled."; Rejected "Case closed." [O]
- **Evidence slots** (8, always listed in this order): doc1 "Identity / legal existence", doc2 "Address evidence", doc3 "Source of funds", doc4 "Ownership structure", doc5 "Bank verification", doc6 "Tax / FATCA / CRS", doc7 "Authority to invest", doc8 "Investment mandate". Required slots: doc1-doc3 for applicant type "Individual", doc1-doc4 for every other type. Card state: file present and not rejected → "Current" (uploaded and accepted are not distinguished); rejected → "Rejected"; no file → "Missing"; source "Applicant upload" or "Requested"; reference "<ONB ref>-DOC<n>". [O]
- **Evidence percentage** = round(received ÷ listed items × 100); live case always lists 8 items, including the 4-5 optional ones, so a complete 4-required application shows 50 %; "Rejected" files count as received. [O]
- **Approval and activation blockers** (server, count shown in UI, text never shown): "Missing evidence: <labels>" (required slot has no file or the file is rejected); "Automated pre-screen still running" (stage Submitted or Screening); "Waiting for the applicant" (stage ClientAction); "Enhanced due diligence open" (stage EnhancedReview); "High risk: enhanced review must be completed first" (risk High, enhanced review not completed, stage not Approved/Activation/Active); "Potential sanctions match to disposition" (latest screening summary "Potential match"). UI gate: *Approve & activate* disabled when the count > 0; *Decline* and *Request information* always enabled. [O]
- **KYC state machine (server)**: stages Submitted, Screening, ComplianceReview, ClientAction, EnhancedReview, Approved, Rejected, Activation, Active (displayed "Compliance review", "Client action", "Enhanced review"). Transitions: public submit or assisted create → Screening; screening worker complete (Submitted/Screening) → ComplianceReview ("Review open"); generic advance allowed only Submitted→Screening, Screening→ComplianceReview, ComplianceReview→ClientAction, ClientAction→ComplianceReview, EnhancedReview→ComplianceReview (marks enhanced due diligence done; others 409 "Cannot move a case from <X> to <Y>"); request-evidence from ComplianceReview/ClientAction/Screening/EnhancedReview → ClientAction; decision approve ComplianceReview → Approved; decision enhanced_review ComplianceReview → EnhancedReview; decision reject from Screening/ComplianceReview/ClientAction/EnhancedReview → Rejected; activate Approved → Activation; Activation → Active automatically when the client has an ACTIVE cash account and an accepted investor user. Reachable from the admin UI: request-evidence, approve (+activate), reject. Not reachable: advance, enhanced_review, assisted create, evidence review. [O]
- **SLA hours per stage**: Submitted 4, Screening 4, ComplianceReview 48, ClientAction 120, EnhancedReview 72, Approved 24, Activation 72; SLA state labels "Within SLA", "Review open", "Client action", "Digital submission", "Ready", "Complete", "Activated". The SLA is not displayed in the final UI. [O]
- **Screening stub (advisory, replaceable by provider)**: runs four checks (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, document). Sanctions "Match" if the legal name or any owner name contains one of the watch-list names "test sanctions match", "ivan sanctioned", "blocked person"; PEP "Review" if the application PEP answer starts with "yes" or any owner is PEP; adverse media "Review" if country or tax residence contains iran, north korea, myanmar, syria, russia or belarus; document "Clear" when ≥ 3 files present else "Review". Risk = High if sanctions hit, PEP or high-risk country; Medium if expected investment ≥ 5,000,000; otherwise Low. Summary = "Potential match" (sanctions match), else "PEP review", else "Review" (any other non-clear), else "Clear". A completed run on a Submitted/Screening case moves it to ComplianceReview. [O]
- **Decision rules** (`POST .../decision`): requires `onboarding.manage`; valid body (`decision` approve | reject | enhanced_review; `reason` 5-4000 characters); step-up MFA; admin `compliance` role (else 403 "Only Compliance can record a KYC decision"); optional version check; dual control when policy `kyc_dual_control` is on: the case's preparer must differ from the decider (else 409 "The person who prepared this case cannot also decide it"); approve only from ComplianceReview with no blockers; approve sets stage Approved, funds approved, SLA "Ready", timeline "Application approved"; reject sets Rejected, SLA "Complete", timeline "Application declined" and emails the applicant "Thank you for your application. After review we are unable to proceed with it at this time."; enhanced_review sets EnhancedReview with timeline "Enhanced review opened". Every decision writes audit `kyc.case.decided` and notifies holders of `onboarding.manage`. [O]
- **Activation** (`POST .../activate`): only from Approved; blocked if risk High without completed enhanced review ("High-risk case: enhanced review approval is required before activation") or funds not approved ("Source of funds has not been approved"). Creates client `CL-#####` (KYC status "Current", base currency from application default USD, risk rating = case risk or "Medium" if Pending, next review date +365 days for High risk else +3 years), mandate `MND-####` (type discretionary, status "Shell"), cash account `CCA-####` (status DRAFT), copies beneficial owners, creates investor-portal admin invitation, moves case to Activation, timeline "Relationship activated", audits `kyc.case.activated` and `client.created`, notifies holders of `cash.approve` ("Draft cash account <CCA-####> created for <client>"). [O]
- **Preparer / dual-control side effects**: request-evidence, advance and screening refresh set the case's preparer to the acting user, so a Compliance officer who did any of these cannot later decide that case when `kyc_dual_control` is on. [O]

##### Edge cases

- If the live list is empty, the V10 layer treats it as "no data" and writes six demo cases into `matanho-onboarding-v10`; V35 then shows them as digital cases and every bridged action on them fails with "Not saved" / "This demo case is not stored on the server." [O]
- The V10/V11 initialisation rewrites stored records (stage names remapped) so localStorage no longer mirrors the server; the V35 view is unaffected because server values override. [O]
- Public-portal submissions have no owner: owner shows blank in cards, header line and chip, and the search text contains "null". [O]
- A High-risk live case cannot progress from the admin UI: no control opens or completes enhanced due diligence, so the blocker "High risk: enhanced review must be completed first" never clears. [O]
- If decision succeeds but activation fails, the case stays Approved; *Approve & activate* is still enabled but re-clicking gives 409 "Cannot approve a case in Approved"; no *Activate* retry exists. [O]
- Activated cases (stage Activation/Active, no blockers) get status "Ready", so they count in *Ready to approve* and the *Ready* filter. [O]
- "Review" (capital R, server summary) scores 25 % in the Screening donut because the test is case-sensitive; "Potential match" and "Queued" also score 25 %; "Sanctions" shows "Review" for "Queued". [O]
- The Mandate donut is always 0 % for live cases ("Not started" / "Shell created"). [O]
- Prototype approve does not recompute the hidden KPI strip, so summary counts go stale until refresh. [O]
- When the filtered queue is empty the detail pane still shows the previously selected case. [O]
- The *Controls & workflow* disclosure re-collapses on every tab click. [O]
- Timeline time is UTC "HH:MM" without a date. [O]
- Arriving from Clients (`activeClientId` set) does not select the matching case. [O]
- Changing the filter select directly leaves the wrong summary tile highlighted. [O]
- A Compliance officer who requests evidence or re-runs screening is barred from deciding that case (dual control) without any UI warning. [O]
- Applicant PII (email, phone, registration reference, owners) persists in browser localStorage across users on a shared machine; logout clearing not verified. [I]
- Rationale of 1-4 characters passes the UI but is rejected by the server with "Record the basis for the decision". [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-169** Evidence-tab *Request* / *Ask question* / *Request evidence* only write to `localStorage["matanho-v53-evidence-requests"]` yet toast "<item> was sent to the secure applicant portal."; no API call, email or timeline entry.
- **DEF-170** Evidence *Preview* always shows a generated mock page titled "APPLICANT EVIDENCE" (applicant literally "Applicant", random "KYC-<6 digits>" reference), never the uploaded file, and the footer text wrongly states the original opens; the bridge's signed-URL path is bypassed by the later evidence layer.
- **DEF-171** The V53 request dialog subtitle shows the wrong applicant name (global drawer title, default "Record").
- **DEF-172** Live queue chip always reads "Digital", hiding risk.
- **DEF-173** Blocker reasons returned by the server are ignored; users see only a count and a disabled *Approve & activate*.
- **DEF-174** No UI for enhanced review, advance, assisted creation, evidence accept/reject or activation retry, although the API supports them.
- **DEF-175** Offline *Decline* cannot decline; offline *Refresh screening* turns "Not run"/"Queued" into "Clear" without a provider; offline approve is lost on reload.
- **DEF-176** Due date (hard-coded 2026-09-04), escalation and message channel are never persisted; *Export case pack* produces no file; *+ Party* is a toast only; suitability selects and digitised-mandate limits are static and identical for every case.
- **DEF-177** Evidence % counts all 8 slots and counts rejected files; screening % is case-sensitive; evidence "Current" does not distinguish uploaded from accepted.
- **DEF-178** Sidebar badge "8" and hidden KPI "Median cycle time 2.4d" / "Final authority Human" are static.
- **DEF-179** No UI RBAC: auditor and other view-only roles see all mutating controls; offline anyone can "approve".
- **DEF-180** Empty live list injects six demo cases (see Edge cases).
- **DEF-181** Message modal does not refresh the timeline after sending.
- **DEF-182** *Decision & audit* tab has no audit trail.
- FR-ONB-016: Hide or disable every mutating control for users without `onboarding.manage`, and hide *Decline* and *Approve & activate* for users without the `compliance` role — AC: a client_services user sees no *Approve & activate*; an auditor sees no mutating control.
- FR-ONB-017: Provide an assisted (staff-captured) application form from *+ New application* using `POST /api/v1/kyc/cases` (applicant type, legal name, email, phone, country, expected investment) — AC: created case shows channel "Assisted", stage Screening, owner = creator.
- FR-ONB-018: Route all evidence requests (including Evidence-tab *Request* / *Ask question*) to `POST /api/v1/kyc/cases/{id}/request-evidence` and show the request on the timeline — AC: request creates a timeline event and applicant email; toast only after server success.
- FR-ONB-019: Preview the original uploaded file via the signed download URL (images, PDF, text) and show Accept / Reject controls using `POST .../evidence/{slot}/review` — AC: reviewer opens the exact uploaded file; reject marks the slot rejected and the case blocker "Missing evidence" returns.
- FR-ONB-020: Show blocker reasons list, risk, SLA state and due time, channel, and the AI/screening exception list (per check: sanctions, PEP, adverse media, document, with outcome and score) in the case detail — AC: every blocker string returned by the API is visible next to the disabled *Approve & activate*.
- FR-ONB-021: Add *Open enhanced review*, *Complete enhanced review* (advance EnhancedReview → ComplianceReview), *Return to review* and *Activate* (retry) actions — AC: a High-risk case can reach Approved and Activation entirely from the UI.
- FR-ONB-022: Persist due date, escalation and message channel and honour them in the applicant email and SLA — AC: stored values appear on the timeline entry.
- FR-ONB-023: Persist suitability inputs to the application and drive the *Mandate* donut from mandate state — AC: reload shows saved values.
- FR-ONB-024: Warn before an action that makes the user the case preparer when dual control is on — AC: confirm text "You will not be able to record the decision on this case."
- FR-ONB-025: Compute evidence % over required slots only, treat uploaded-unreviewed as "Under review", and make screening % case-insensitive — AC: complete 4-required application shows 100 %.
- FR-ONB-026: Pre-select the matching case when arriving from Clients or notifications; compute the sidebar badge from open cases; produce a real case-pack export (evidence manifest, hashes, screening references, decision rationale, audit events) — AC: export downloads a file.
- BR-038: Cases in Activation and Active must not count as "Ready to approve".
- BR-039: The production UI must not store applicant PII in browser storage.
- Q-51: Should the queue show a SLA-breach indicator and default sort by blockers, risk and SLA (as the V33 header claimed)? — default: sort by SLA due ascending, show "Overdue" chip.
- Q-52: Is the "Applicant portal" link intended for staff to demonstrate or to onboard on behalf of a client? — default: demonstration only; assisted flow handled by the new form.

##### Business rules & calculations

- BR-040: KPI tiles, chart counts, the result count and the CSV export are all derived from the same filtered set so they always agree. **[O]**
- BR-041: date presets are anchored to the period end (fixed 2026-08-31 in the prototype), not the system clock. **[O]** Production anchor is a decision (see Q-NEW below).
- BR-042: a report whose status is *Review* is counted as "Awaiting review" and requires a human sign-off before release; client and regulatory outputs need a human reviewer. **[I]** (text only)
- BR-043: the official NAV / performance period must be locked before a report is published; one material data exception blocks a report. **[I]** (text only; ties to 5.A.8 *Lock official return* and 5.A.18)
- BR-044: numeric fields in a report are bound to approved source data; manual edits are flagged as overrides; every save creates an audit checkpoint. **[I]** (editor copy only)
- BR-001 (maker ≠ checker) applies to reports at approval; the editor approval route (Prepared → Review → Approve → Publish) implies Draft → In review → Approved → Published. **[I]**
- Roles: only `reports.view` is enforced; `reports.create` should gate +Report, *Save draft* and *Submit for approval*. **[P]**

##### Edge cases

- From date later than To date → empty result set, no warning. **[O]**
- Typing a date does not clear the active preset until the field's `change` event fires. **[O]**
- *ALL* preset sets preset to `ALL`, clears both dates and shows sub-text "Start → Latest" on the first KPI. **[O]**
- *Status* sort is alphabetical (Draft, Published, Review), not workflow order. **[O]**
- Export with a filter yielding zero rows downloads the header line only and toasts "0 filtered rows exported." **[O]**
- Clicking a second row replaces the open preview; closing hides it but retains content. **[O]**
- On narrow screens (≤ 760 px) table headers disappear and cells show their column label as a prefix. **[O]**
- Editor outline buttons *Risk & compliance* and *Transactions* do not scroll (no matching heading). **[O]**
- Closing the editor discards edits; *Back to edit* from the preview preserves them. **[O]**
- The Escape key closes the report editor / preview modals but not the *Create report* dialog. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-183** the page ships two incompatible report datasets (14-row V34 array in use; V33 six-row and original five-row arrays dead). Only one source of truth should exist.
- **DEF-184** *+ Report* → *Create draft* does nothing (no validation, no row, no toast, no persistence); the subtitle promises "period" and "publication authority" fields that do not exist.
- **DEF-185** *Schedules* is a toast with no screen or form.
- **DEF-186** every preview shows the same hard-coded metrics (US$ 84.62m, 12.84%, 10.74%, +2.10%) regardless of report; the V33 audience-specific papers were lost when V34 replaced the page.
- **DEF-187** *Export PDF package* produces no file; *Print / PDF* prints the whole page.
- **DEF-188** editor *Save draft* and *Submit for approval* show success toasts but persist nothing and enforce no permission or workflow; editor caption "Autosave on · audit history enabled" is untrue; document controls (period, currency, classification) have no handler; the data bindings and approval route are static.
- **DEF-189** editor default reporting currency is *ZWG* (first option) while the template text says base currency USD.
- **DEF-190** *Publication control* card states rules that are not enforced (period lock, material exception, human reviewer).
- **DEF-191** the report editor is unreachable from the Reports page; only the `client` template is reachable (from Clients).
- **DEF-192** `reports.create` is not enforced on any control; Dealer and Operations are denied but Auditor (view only) sees enabled create/export controls.
- **DEF-193** the *Create report* dialog and V34 workbench modals do not close on Escape.
- **DEF-194** date presets anchor on the fixed date 2026-08-31.
- FR-DOC-007: *+ Report* opens a definition form requiring title, type, audience, frequency, reporting period and data products, and creates a report in status Draft owned by the current user — AC: submitting with any required field empty shows the field error and creates nothing; a valid submit adds the row to the library with status *Draft* and an audit event.
- FR-DOC-008: report editor reachable from a report row (Edit/Open) for Draft reports and from Clients for a client report; Save persists content and increments a version; Submit moves Draft → In review — AC: reopening a saved draft shows the saved content; Submit disabled without `reports.create`.
- FR-DOC-009: report approval enforces maker ≠ checker and the approval route (Review · Compliance, Approve · Investment Director, Publish · Client Services) — AC: the maker cannot approve their own report; a published report cannot return to Draft without a new version.
- FR-DOC-010: *Schedules* opens a schedule manager (report/template, frequency, run time, reviewer, due offset, recipients) producing a Draft report for review on each run — AC: a schedule due today creates one Draft and no Published output.
- FR-DOC-011: report previews render per report type (Investor, Investment committee, Risk, Management, Regulatory) with report-specific data and explicit source lineage — AC: two reports of different types show different sections; every metric shows its source.
- FR-DOC-012: *Export register* and *Export PDF package* produce the filtered CSV and an approved PDF with evidence manifest from the API — AC: PDF generated only for an Approved or Published report and audited.
- FR-DOC-013: `reports.create` gates +Report, Save draft, Submit; Auditor is view-only — AC: with only `reports.view` these controls are disabled with title "Not permitted for <role>".
- BR-045: workflow vocabulary for reports is Draft, In review, Awaiting approval, Approved, Published (Appendix B); the running UI uses Draft, Review, Published only. The target must map *Review* → *In review* (or *Awaiting approval*) and render the full chain.
- Q-53: should presets anchor on the system date, the last locked period end, or a user-chosen as-of date? — default: system date in the Africa/Harare timezone, with an optional as-of override.
- Q-54: is "Awaiting review" a single state or the pair In review + Awaiting approval? — default: count both as "Awaiting review".
- Q-55: which of the four editor templates (client, compliance, investment, management) are in scope for phase 1? — default: all four, selected from the template catalogue.
- Q-56: should the Regulatory report type link to 5.A.22 filings (the V33 link *Regulatory reporting* was dropped)? — default: restore a header link to the Regulatory Reporting workspace.
- Q-57: what is the retention and versioning policy for generated report PDFs? — default: store each published PDF as a document version in the vault with the vault's default retention (7 years).

##### States

- Empty: the register body is empty with no message when filters exclude every row; preview pane absent until a row is clicked. **[O]**
- Loading: none in the vault (static data). In live mode the bridge delays prototype start until the document list has loaded (or a timeout). **[O]**
- Error: none on the vault page. Bridge failures show toast "Not saved" / server message (type error); step-up cancelled → "Confirmation cancelled". **[O]**
- Disabled / read-only: no vault control is disabled by role. In the document modal lifecycle buttons are absent unless `documents.edit` and the right status; the restricted download is refused by the server for non-entitled users. **[O]**
- Conditional: advanced panel hidden by default; preview template depends on category and title keywords; lifecycle buttons depend on status and classification; the *Publish* prompt appears only when the document has no linked client. **[O]**

##### Business rules & calculations

- BR-046: document lifecycle is Draft → In review → Approved → Published; *Return* sends In review or Approved back to Draft with a reason; *Withdraw* removes publications and reverts to Approved; a new version always resets to Draft (and withdraws a Published document from investors until re-approved). **[O]** (server)
- BR-001 (maker ≠ checker) applies to document approval when the `document_approval` policy is on (default on); approval additionally requires MFA step-up. **[O]** (server)
- BR-047: only documents classified *Client* or *Public* can be published to investors; *Internal* and *Restricted* cannot (error "<classification> documents cannot be published to investors"). **[O]** (server)
- BR-048: a *Restricted* document can be downloaded only by a user holding `audit.view` or by its maker; every download is audited. **[O]** (server)
- BR-049: download links are short-lived signed URLs (expiry 300 seconds). **[O]** (server)
- BR-050: documents are never deleted through the API; retention years per document default to 7 (range 1–50). **[O]**; legal-hold blocking is [I]
- BR-051: file storage is encrypted at rest with a recorded SHA-256 per version. **[O]**
- BR-052: optimistic locking — a lifecycle call supplying a stale version returns "This record was changed by someone else. Reload and try again." **[O]**
- BR-053: publish creates a Pending signature request per client when the document requires a signature. **[O]**
- BR-054: allowed upload types pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, png, jpg; ≤ 25 MB; malware scan before availability; classification required. **[P]** (the server accepts a wider MIME list and performs no scan)

##### Edge cases

- Filters stay applied while the advanced panel is hidden; there is no reset control. **[O]**
- *Updated from* and *Signature state* change nothing. **[O]**
- Two rows hit the generic preview template with different categories; the template choice is purely keyword-based on category + title. **[O]**
- Clicking a different row while a preview is open replaces it. **[O]**
- *Fit width* only sets width to 100% (no zoom levels). **[O]**
- Version buttons in the prototype modal always show v3 / v2 / v1 regardless of the document. **[O]**
- Publishing an already Published document is allowed (button labelled *Re-publish*) and re-activates withdrawn publications. **[O]**
- Withdraw with no client given ends every active publication; when none remain the status returns to Approved. **[O]**
- The server permits *Return* on an Approved document although the modal offers it only for In review. **[O]**
- Upload of a file whose browser-reported MIME is empty is stored as octet-stream (accepted). **[O]**
- Folder-derived classification on upload (compliance → Restricted) can make a document unpublishable. **[O]**

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-195** the vault table renders six hard-coded rows and ignores the live `/api/v1/documents` list; the bridge-loaded array is unused on this page.
- **DEF-196** *Upload document* and *Retention policy* are informational toasts; the working upload, versioning, lifecycle and export code is unreachable because the document modal cannot be opened from the vault.
- **DEF-197** *Updated from* and *Signature state* filters render but are not wired; no empty-state message; no reset.
- **DEF-198** KPI tiles are static (1,284 / 7 / 12 / 96 / 31 / 4) and inconsistent with the six-row table.
- **DEF-199** `documents.edit` is not enforced on the vault page controls (the original and bridged upload paths do enforce it).
- **DEF-200** server and client upload rules diverge (client picker accept lists differ; server accepts webp and zip and octet-stream, performs no malware scan, defaults classification to *Client*).
- **DEF-201** the document-modal *Edit* button opens the report editor on a copy of the preview HTML with no persistence and no permission check; prototype *Create new version* only bumps a label.
- **DEF-202** lifecycle uses browser `prompt()` dialogs for reasons and the client reference; the *Publish* prompt accepts free text.
- **DEF-203** the bridge shows *Return to maker* only for In review although the API also allows return from Approved.
- **DEF-204** the document-modal version list is hard-coded v3 / v2 / v1 in prototype mode.
- **DEF-205** global search lists documents but result buttons have no handler.
- FR-DOC-014: row click opens the document modal (metadata, access, version history, lifecycle) over the live document list — AC: clicking any row loads the document by reference and shows its API metadata and versions.
- FR-DOC-015: *Upload document* opens a form capturing name, type, classification (required), client, related record, document date, requires-signature, retention years and file — AC: submit with a missing required field shows the field error and sends nothing; a valid submit creates a Draft with version 1, an audit event and a toast "Document uploaded".
- FR-DOC-016: upload validation allows pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, png, jpg up to 25 MB, requires a malware scan result of clean before the file is available for preview or download — AC: an infected or unscanned file is held and cannot be downloaded.
- FR-DOC-017: *Retention policy* opens a screen listing retention schedules and legal holds with create/edit and a hold flag that blocks deletion/expiry — AC: a document under hold cannot be purged; schedule changes are audited.
- FR-DOC-018: wire Updated from, Signature state and a classification filter, add a filter reset and an empty-state message "No documents match the selected filters." — AC: each filter changes the result set; clearing restores all rows.
- FR-DOC-019: compute KPI tiles from data (documents, needs signature, expiring in 30 days, restricted, evidence packs, retention holds) — AC: tile values equal the corresponding counts of the filtered or total register as specified.
- FR-DOC-020: preview renders the original file (PDF/image) alongside metadata for uploaded documents and business-specific templates for system-generated records, with access logging — AC: opening a document records an audit event; an uploaded PDF displays its own pages.
- FR-DOC-021: enforce `documents.edit` on Upload, Create new version, Edit and lifecycle actions in the UI, disabled with title "Not permitted for <role>" — AC: Dealer and Auditor see these controls disabled.
- FR-DOC-022: replace `prompt()` dialogs with modal forms (reason min 3 characters; client picker for publish) — AC: submit disabled until the reason has at least 3 characters.
- Q-58: should document type taxonomy in the UI be the five categories (Client, Investment, Operations, Regulatory, Governance) or the API types/folders (research, ic, clients, compliance, valuations, legal, …)? — default: keep the API types as the stored value and show the five categories as a derived filter.
- Q-59: is the *Restricted* download rule (`audit.view` or maker) sufficient, or should it use entitlement groups? — default: keep `audit.view` or maker plus an explicit entitlement list per document.
- Q-60: does *Needs signature* / *Expiring* status belong to the lifecycle status or to separate flags? — default: separate flags (signature state, expiry date) alongside the lifecycle status.
- Q-61: statutory retention periods per class (see Q-15) — default: 7 years audit/financial, 5 years KYC post-exit.

- Filters **[O]**: asset class, data state, and text search combine with AND. Exact logic: a row shows when (search is empty or the lower-cased text "<ticker> <name> <portfolio> <asset class>" contains the lower-cased, trimmed search text) and (asset filter is "all" or equals the row's asset class) and (state filter is "all" or equals the row's state). Matching is case-insensitive for the search and exact for the selects.
- Search covers ticker, security name, portfolio and asset class only. ISIN is not searched and no ISIN exists in the data **[O]**.
