##### States

- Empty: no exceptions (all funds except Balanced Growth, or after resolution) shows the green panel "No unresolved material valuation exceptions" with chip *Clear* **[O]**. No empty state exists for "no funds", "no run" or "no history" **[I]**.
- Loading: none specified; for about 3.8 s after load the static V33 page is visible and interactive (with V33 handlers) before v49 replaces it; no spinner, no skeleton **[O]**. Long NAV runs should be asynchronous with job polling (NFR-PERF-003) **[P]**.
- Error: none. There is no data fetch, so no error path; the bridge "live data unavailable" fallback does not apply to NAV **[O]**. API errors (409 maker blocked, 403 same-user release, 409 released run) are **[P]**.
- Disabled / read-only: only *Release NAV* is disabled (until maker done and no unresolved exception, and again once released). *Submit maker review* is never disabled; after maker review it only changes its label to *Maker reviewed* **[O]**. No role-based disabling **[O]**.
- Conditional: *Balanced Growth Fund* opens Blocked with the exception; the other three funds open at the "ready for maker" point but the *Release state* tile shows "Blocked" in amber because the tile only has three labels (quirk) **[O]**. Switching funds keeps each fund's progress **[O]**. Page reload resets every fund **[O]**.
- Permission denied: see Access **[O]**.

##### Business rules & calculations

NAV run state machine (per fund; derived, not stored) **[O]**:

```
Blocked (exception && !resolved)
   --Resolve & revalue (rationale required)--> Ready for maker (tile still reads "Blocked", amber)
   --Submit maker review--> Ready for checker (maker && !blocked)
   --Release NAV--> Released (terminal; Recalculate still allowed and only increments the version)
```

- `blocked = exception && !resolved`; *Release state* = *Released* if released, else *Ready for checker* if maker done and not blocked, else *Blocked* **[O]**.
- Funds without an exception start at "ready for maker" **[O]**. There is no Draft/Calculating/Failed state, no reopen/unrelease, no return-to-maker, no Superseded state **[O]**.
- FR-VAL-001: each recalculation increments the calculation version, shown as `NAV-<valuation date>.<n>` **[O]**.
- FR-VAL-002 / FR-VAL-003: maker review is refused while a material exception is unresolved; resolution requires a non-blank rationale and optional evidence **[O]** (backend 409 not implemented).
- FR-VAL-004: release requires maker review done and no unresolved exception **[O]**; the "different user" rule is **[I]** (not enforced).
- BR-012: NAV = positions market value + cash + accruals − fees/liabilities; NAV/unit = NAV ÷ units outstanding to 4 dp **[I]** (values are hard-coded, not calculated). BR-013: price coverage = valued positions ÷ total positions by market value, material exception when difference exceeds tolerance (default 1 % or US$ 50k, Q-13) **[I]**. BR-001 / BR-019: approver must differ from maker **[I]** on this page. BR-005: policy `navApproval` (*Independent checker required* / *Dual control*) **[I]** (stored but unused).
- Recalculation / resolution effects **[O]**: Recalculate changes only the version; resolution changes version, Draft NAV (to 21.989) and NAV/unit (to 2.4353) with literal constants.
- Constants **[O]**: valuation date 31 Aug 2026; cut-offs 16:00 CAT and 15:30 CAT; timezone Africa/Harare; evidence "generated" date 01 Sep 2026; exception difference US$ 150k, -3.4 %, 4.31m vs 4.46m; resolution draft 21.989 and unit 2.4353. No tolerance, staleness or movement thresholds exist.
- BR-068: recalculating a run after maker review or after release invalidates the maker review, and a released run may only be corrected by a new superseding version (FR-VAL-005) **[P]**.
- BR-069: the NAV exception list, price coverage and release gates (*Source evidence current*, *Cash reconciled*, *Material exceptions*, *Maker review*) are computed from live source status, reconciliation sign-off and exception state, not static labels **[P]**.
- Implied but not implemented **[I]**: calculation version, source snapshots, overrides and reconciliation sign-offs are frozen with the release; release updates the official NAV and PBOR publication state ("PBOR remains unchanged" until release); only `fund_accountant` runs NAV; `auditor` is read-only; materiality, stale-price thresholds and override governance are defined in the valuation policy. The Vault policy preview states the hierarchy: listed securities → approved exchange / broker close (authority Fund Accounting); private assets → administrator / manager NAV plus independent support (authority Valuation checker); overrides → documented rationale and source snapshot (authority independent approval).

##### Edge cases

- *Submit maker review* can be pressed again after maker review or after release and repeats the success toast **[O]**.
- *Recalculate* after release keeps *Released* and only increments the version **[O]**.
- Switching funds preserves each fund's progress; reload loses everything **[O]**.
- A whitespace-only rationale passes the native `required` check but the handler silently returns **[O]**.
- A file chosen in the drawer is discarded **[O]**.
- The bridge stops reconciling after the exception is resolved **[O]**.
- The stored currency "USD eq." for *Zimbabwe Opportunities* is ignored; amounts show "US$" **[O]**.
- Compact currency uses the browser locale and renders negatives as "US$ -55K" and zero as "+US$ 0" **[O]**.
- The FX evidence has no numeric rate; the IBOR and cash evidence are identical for every fund; the *Private valuation* input row exists only for the fund with an exception **[O]**.
- Price coverage 99.6 % on *Zimbabwe Opportunities* shows "All material inputs controlled" **[O]**.
- A fund awaiting maker review shows the amber label "Blocked" **[O]**.
- Dashboard shortcut `valuation-exception` falls back to the work-queue layer **[O]**.

##### Gaps, defects & open questions

- **DEF-257** No action-level permission on this page; all seven roles holding `valuation.view` (including `auditor`, `compliance`, `investment_director`, `portfolio_manager`, `system_admin`) can recalculate, resolve, submit maker review and release.
- **DEF-258** Maker and checker are not separated: the same user can submit maker review and release; the `navApproval` policy is stored but never consulted (BR-001, BR-005, FR-VAL-004).
- **DEF-259** NAV / unit is hard-coded and inconsistent for *Zimbabwe Opportunities* (shown 4.2281, computed 4.2289); *Balanced Growth* is truncated (2.4187 vs 2.41876) rather than rounded.
- **DEF-260** After resolution Draft NAV and NAV/unit are overwritten with constants and the bridge no longer sums; there is no "valuation adjustment / override" bridge line.
- **DEF-261** Recalculate changes only the version and does not recompute figures or reset maker/released state.
- **DEF-262** Resolution rationale and evidence are discarded; no audit record, no independent approval of the override.
- **DEF-263** *Release state* shows "Blocked" (amber) for funds that are only awaiting maker review.
- **DEF-264** *Price coverage* never changes on resolution; 99.6 % for *Zimbabwe Opportunities* is described as fully controlled.
- **DEF-265** Source-row statuses, release gates *Source evidence current* / *Cash reconciled* and per-fund IBOR/cash evidence are static; the FX evidence has no rate.
- **DEF-266** Dashboard items *Resolve private valuation exception* and *Valuation release exception* open the generic work queue because `valuation-exception` has no layer definition.
- **DEF-267** The exception (REC-66155 / REC-NAV-GEIV, "Pricing / NAV", US$ 150k, owner Fund Accounting) appears on Reconciliations (shown "Pending checker" in later layers) and in the Operations runbook ("16:30 Valuation – Review private asset price exception – Blocked", "17:00 Close – Prepare NAV close readiness – Blocked") with unlinked state; resolving one does not update the others.
- **DEF-268** Status text is printed twice in the source rows (text and chip); evidence date "Q3 valuation statement" is inconsistent with a 31 Aug valuation; negative compact amounts render "US$ -55K"; the `ccy` field is ignored; the *NAV pack* omits the "+" sign on market movement.
- **DEF-269** *NAV history* and *Valuation policy* entry points existed in V33 and are absent from the final UI.
- **DEF-270** Dead code references an unrelated OMU.ZW stale price (`price-exceptions`, `start-nav-run`, `review-valuation-evidence`, `startNavRunV9`); exclude from requirements.
- **DEF-271** The page has no link to Reconciliations, Accounting, Operations, Vault or Audit.
- FR-VAL-009: Gate *Recalculate* / *Resolve exception* with `valuation.run`, *Submit maker review* with `valuation.maker` and *Release NAV* with `valuation.release` (Q-04), and enforce checker ≠ maker honouring the `navApproval` policy — AC: a same-user release returns 403 and `auditor` sees all action buttons disabled with tooltip "Not permitted for `<Role>`".
- FR-VAL-010: Compute Draft NAV, NAV/unit (4 dp, rounded) and price coverage from governed positions, cash, prices/FX, fees and units — AC: NAV/unit = Draft NAV ÷ units; bridge components sum exactly to Draft NAV, including an override adjustment line.
- FR-VAL-011: Persist each exception with rationale, evidence document, resolver and timestamp, and route a material override to an independent approver — AC: resolving without rationale returns validation error "Resolution rationale is required."; evidence upload accepts pdf, csv, xlsx, xls, png, jpg, jpeg and is linked to the exception.
- FR-VAL-012: Recalculation after maker review or release creates a new calculation version and clears the maker review (released runs are superseded, FR-VAL-005) — AC: after *Recalculate*, *Maker reviewed* returns to *Submit maker review* and *Release NAV* is disabled.
- FR-VAL-013: Show the release state as *Blocked*, *Ready for maker*, *Ready for checker* or *Released* — AC: a fund with no unresolved exception and no maker review shows *Ready for maker*.
- FR-VAL-014: Link the exception to its reconciliation break and the Operations runbook task, and add outbound links to Reconciliations and Accounting — AC: resolving the NAV exception updates the break status and the runbook row.
- FR-VAL-015: Reinstate *NAV history* (prior official NAVs, re-runs, release evidence) and *Valuation policy* (price hierarchy, stale-price thresholds, override governance) — AC: both open from the page head and show data from the API.
- FR-VAL-016: Replace the preview documents with generated evidence from source snapshots (position snapshot, cash certificate, ZSE/VFEX closes, FX rates with numeric values, fee/unit control, private valuation statement, NAV pack) with source timestamps and version — AC: each *Preview* shows real values and a version-stamped footer.
- Q-78: Which value is authoritative for the Growth Equity IV exception (administrator US$ 4.31m or approved valuation US$ 4.46m), and in which direction does resolution move the NAV — default: the maker documents the authoritative value; the resolved value is recorded and the draft NAV recalculated from it.
- Q-79: What are the stale-price threshold, NAV-movement tolerance and override materiality per asset class (refines Q-13) — default: 1 % or US$ 50k.
- Q-80: Is the NAV maker a role (`fund_accountant`) or a permission, and who is the independent NAV checker — default: permissions `valuation.maker` and `valuation.release` held by different users.
- Q-81: Should the valuation currency for *Zimbabwe Opportunities* (ZWG fund) be displayed in ZWG with a USD equivalent — default: show the fund currency with a USD-equivalent line using the valuation-date FX (BR-018).

##### Business rules & calculations
- The period cannot close while any checklist gate is "!". The prototype shows this rule as copy only; it is not enforced (FR-VAL-006). [O copy]
- The two visible blockers are cash suspense US$ 5 and one stale-price override awaiting checker sign-off. [O]
- Journals follow maker-checker (BR-001, BR-019). Makers are shown ("Maker C. Dube", "Maker S. Moyo"); checker actions do not exist. [O copy]
- FR-VAL-017: Variance = External NAV − ABOR value, and State = Agree when |Variance| ≤ tolerance (Q-13). — AC: a fund with ABOR 9.558M and external 9.552M shows variance US$ 6k and a non-Agree state.

- Journal IDs on the page (JRN-260826-032/041) differ from the IDs on the second level (JRN-44021/44022). [O]
- Every basis tile opens identical drawer content. [O]

##### States
- Empty: none coded. With zero facilities the utilisation tile shows "NaN% of committed capacity". [O]
- Loading: none. [O]
- Error: corrupt localStorage → silently reset to seed data. [O]
- Disabled / read-only: none. [O]
- Conditional: the attention list shows only non-Funded calls. The margin modal primary label depends on state. The import footnote appears only after an import. [O]

##### Business rules & calculations
- Utilised = Σdrawn; Available = Σ(committed − drawn); utilisation % = Σdrawn ÷ Σcommitted. [O]
- Weighted funding cost = Σ(cost × drawn) ÷ max(0.01, Σdrawn). Computed but not displayed. [O]
- Margin requiring action = Σ call over calls with state ≠ Funded. [O]
- Margin state machine today: Disputed → Due → Funded (buttons). No reasons, no maker-checker. [O]
- New facility starts in *Review* with drawn = 0. [O]
- BR-070: A margin dispute resolution records reason, counterparty evidence and the house calculation; funding a call requires maker ≠ checker and creates a cash expectation (FR-FIN-002).

##### Edge cases
- Committed or cost = 0 is rejected by the truthy check. [O]
- Facility IDs are derived from array length and can collide if deletion is added. [O]
- *Mark funded* on an already-Funded call re-sets Funded and repeats the toast. [O]
- After *Tight* or *Stress*, the curve points lose their tooltips. [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-276** *Collateral after haircut* is hard-coded (4.18) and does not derive from the pool tiles (2.10 + 3.42 + 1.86 = 7.38).
- **DEF-277** Funding-decision rows are static text and do not follow facility edits.
- **DEF-278** Funding-curve point click does nothing; tooltips are lost after a scenario switch.
- **DEF-279** Zero committed/cost values are rejected; zero facilities yields "NaN%".
- **DEF-280** No permission or maker-checker on margin disposition or on facility creation.
- FR-FIN-004: Margin disposition (resolve dispute / mark funded) requires `financing.manage` (Q-04), a reason, and an independent checker. — AC: the maker cannot fund their own proposed disposition (403); an audit event with before/after state is written.
- FR-FIN-005: Statement import parses rows into margin calls after schema and control-total validation. — AC: a CSV with a mismatched control total is rejected and no call changes.
- Q-84: Is collateral posted per facility or per counterparty CSA? — default: per counterparty CSA.

##### Business rules & calculations
- Registration requires name, purpose, dataset, dataset version, method, assumptions and a passed test suite. [O]
- A registered model is never production-approved automatically. State = *Independent validation*. [O]
- No transitions exist after registration (no approve, promote, retire or finding workflow). [O]
- BR-074: The validator and the approval committee must be independent of the model owner. Production promotion requires closed high-severity findings and committee approval recorded by `models.approve` (Q-04).

##### Edge cases
- Clone of 4.2 produces version "4.300000000000001" (floating-point addition). [O]
- Model IDs are derived from the count, so clones can collide with existing IDs. [O]
- The build card H2 does not switch to "Create / change model" when *+ New model* is pressed; it only changes after a page rebuild. [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-292** *Clone as new version* copies seed models that have no `datasetVersion` or `assumptions`. Pressing *Continue* on step 2 or step 3 without typing into those fields throws a TypeError (`undefined.trim()`). The wizard silently stops advancing.
- **DEF-293** The clone version is computed as floating-point number + 0.1 (for example 4.300000000000001).
- **DEF-294** *Data exclusions / transformations*, *Change class* and *Acceptance standard* are captured on screen but never stored.
- **DEF-295** *Discard* has no confirmation. *Save draft* is not persisted.
- **DEF-296** The Owner select ignores the draft value, so a cloned model owned by Valuation shows Risk Analytics.
- FR-MOD-002: Model lifecycle actions *Record validation findings*, *Approve for production* (committee, `models.approve`) and *Retire*. — AC: a model with an open high-severity finding cannot be approved (409).
- FR-MOD-003: Overdue validation is flagged in the registry and on the Command Centre (FR-MOD-001). — AC: a model with a validation date in the past shows an amber "Validation due" chip.

- Keyword routing (lower-cased question, first match wins) [O]:

  | private\|commitment\|unfunded\|valuation | "Private markets are 21.4% of the selected whole-portfolio NAV." Unfunded US$ 8.74M; Growth Equity IV stale US$ 4.46M NAV, US$ 1.62M unfunded; 90-day −US$ 1.46M; floor 1.19× | Private Markets · investment inventory; Private Markets · valuation control; Cash & Ledgers | *Open private book*, *Run cashflow case* |
  | risk\|stress\|limit\|delta\|issuer | "The closest active portfolio constraint is Delta single-issuer exposure." (91% of the 10% limit) | Risk · limit book; Orders · pre-trade checks; Research & IC · issuer evidence; IBOR · current position | *Open risk*, *Open orders*, *Create draft stress* |
  | model\|data\|lineage\|source | "The answer is grounded in governed data products, not a separate AI copy of the portfolio." | Data Fabric · data products; Model Governance · AI-COP-02; Audit · entitlement policy | *Open Data Fabric*, *Open model governance* |
  | (default) | "I can analyse the selected whole-portfolio scope." | Whole Portfolio; IBOR; Risk & Compliance; Data Fabric | *Open whole portfolio*, *Open my work* |
- Copilot cannot perform approvals, cash movement, bank changes, period close, KYC approval or publication (FR-COP-001). This is true today only because no such actions exist on the page. [O]
- BR-075: Copilot answers may cite only objects the requesting user is entitled to read. A question whose sources are all out of entitlement returns guidance without data.

##### States
- Empty: none (the users list always has seed rows or live rows). [O]
- Loading: the live SoD list updates asynchronously after the local list. [O]
- Error: any rejected call → toast "Not saved" / "{server message}" (or "The server rejected this action."). A cancelled step-up → "Not saved" / "Confirmation cancelled". [O]
- Disabled / read-only: the system_admin column is not rendered. The *Reset MFA* button is absent for yourself and for users without MFA. [O]
- Conditional: Reset is a no-op toast in live mode. Invitation rows cannot change role. The role switcher lists only held roles plus a preview role in live mode. [O]

##### Business rules & calculations
- Local SoD rules [O]:
  - order approval ≠ independent → "Order maker-checker relaxed";
  - cash approval ≠ independent → "Cash maker-checker relaxed";
  - more than 2 System Administrators → "Privileged account count";
  - system_admin bundle containing any of orders.create, orders.approve, orders.route, cash.journal.create, cash.journal.approve, cash.close → "Platform admin monetary privilege";
  - otherwise ✓ "No blocking SoD conflicts" / "Independent approval policies are active and platform administrators have no monetary permissions." / "Controlled".
- Server SoD rules: see `=== SECTION 4 ===` 4.5.
- The order maker's role cannot approve the same order while order approval = independent: toast "Maker-checker conflict" / "The role that created this order cannot approve the same order while independent approval is enforced. Switch to an authorised independent approver." [O]
- Policy enforcement in the live API [O]:
  - `cash_approval` (cash-account and capital-event checker ≠ maker);
  - `document_approval` and `client_publish_approval` (maker ≠ checker);
  - `session_idle_minutes` (idle expiry, capped by server configuration);
  - `mfa_required` (forced enrolment on MFA portals).
  - `order_approval`, NAV approval and bank approval are stored but not enforced by any API.

##### Edge cases
- Removing `dashboard.view` from a role has no guard. [O]
- The role-builder *Description* is discarded. [O]
- The session timeout accepts 0 or 1000 locally; only the server rejects it. [O]
- In live mode the KPI *Active users* counts invitations. [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-300** Prototype *Reset defaults* restores bundles cloned **before** `onboarding.manage` was added, so Investment Director, Compliance and Client Services lose `onboarding.manage` until the page is reloaded.
- **DEF-301** The *Access policy* KPI tile is static "Enforced" and never reflects relaxed policies.
- **DEF-302** The v52 row-click layer hides the users-table *Preview* button (whenever it is the only row button) and turns the whole row into a preview trigger.
- **DEF-303** Session-timeout min/max are not enforced client-side. The role *Description* is not stored.
- **DEF-304** The matrix card copy says "Sensitive changes are retained in the local audit log for this prototype", but no local audit log exists.
- FR-RBAC-009: *Disable / enable user* and *Revoke invitation* controls on the users table (the API already supports `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id} {isActive}`). — AC: a disabled user's sessions are revoked; you cannot disable yourself (409).
- FR-RBAC-010: Matrix rows for `cash.approve` (and read-only rows for `admin.rbac` / `admin.settings`). — AC: `cash.approve` can be granted to Compliance and appears in the access review.
- Q-87: Should permission-bundle changes require a second administrator's approval (maker-checker on RBAC)? — default: yes for monetary codes.

- Empty: configuration audit shows "Default configuration loaded". Integration cards always exist. [O]

##### Business rules & calculations
- Settings are applied immediately after a successful save (density, breadcrumbs, quick-order defaults, participation cap, risk horizon, letterhead). [O]
- An integration can be tested only after configuration. The prototype test always passes. [O]
- BR-076: A setting change is audited with before/after values (the server already writes `settings.updated`); settings with no consumer must be removed or wired before release.

##### Edge cases
- The configuration-audit list is lost on reload. [O]
- Cancelling the editor of a newly added integration leaves a "New integration" card. [O]
- The logo is stored as a data URL string. [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-305** In live mode every *Save settings* fails. The settings payload contains a nested `letterhead` object (and a logo data URL far over 200 characters), but the server only accepts scalar values (string ≤200, number, boolean, null). The request is rejected with "Not saved" and no setting is applied. *Reset defaults* also sends a nested `letterhead` and fails server-side after already resetting locally.
- **DEF-306** 13 of the settings have no consumer: research evidence, liquidity horizon, warning utilisation, auto re-run, three ingestion toggles, research freshness, and four notification toggles. Timezone and default landing page have only a cosmetic effect.
- **DEF-307** *Reset defaults* and *Disconnect* have no confirmation. Numeric min/max are not enforced.
- **DEF-308** The Digital KYC policy values are neither saved nor used; the KYC engine hard-codes 1,000,000 and 35/65.
- **DEF-309** The Security & resilience card and drawer values are static.
- FR-SET-002: Letterhead stored as a structured setting with the logo as an uploaded asset reference. — AC: saving a 500 KB logo succeeds and the report editor shows it after reload.
- FR-DATA-004: Integration registry persisted server-side with secret references, test history and health (FR-DATA-001). — AC: the secret never appears in any API response; *Test* records a timestamp and outcome.

##### Modals & drawers
360 drawers (D17 Portfolio 360, D18 Client 360, D19 Order 360, D51 Position 360, D07 cash account), D62 client editor, D99 portfolio holding, and the KYC and reconciliation drawers. See the drawer table in 5.A.30.

##### States
- Empty: *No linked account*; "No linked orders / Create an instruction from Order Management."; holdings count 0 after filtering. [O]
- Loading / Error: none. An unresolved ID falls back to the first record of its type. [O]
- Disabled: none. [O]
- Conditional: *Client portal* button only for active onboarding clients; the stat strip is omitted when a layer has no stats. [O]

##### Business rules & calculations
- Open orders = orders for the portfolio whose status is not in {Filled, Cancelled}. [O]
- Cash-account count = cash accounts whose portfolio equals the selected portfolio. [O]
- The detail page inherits the parent's permission. Leaving it restores the parent page. [O]

##### Edge cases
- Turning off *Keep second-level breadcrumbs* removes the only in-page back control. [O]
- An unknown ID shows the first record of that type (portfolios[0], clients[0], break REC-66102, application default). [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-311** An unknown layer type (for example `valuation-exception` from the v37 Command Centre) silently opens the *Prioritised work queue* instead of an error or the intended record.
- **DEF-312** An unknown record ID silently shows another record (the first one), so users can act on the wrong record.
- **DEF-313** Hiding breadcrumbs through Settings also hides the back button.
- FR-PLAT-001: Second-level pages are addressable URLs (`/{parent}/{type}/{id}`) with a 404 state for unknown IDs. — AC: opening an unknown ID shows "Record not found" with a link back to the parent page.

Document modal: **Bridged** in live mode (`GET /api/v1/documents/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/versions`, `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/{submit\|return\|approve\|publish\|withdraw}`, `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/download-url[?version=]`). |

##### Layout
1. **Detail drawer**: right-hand panel with head (eyebrow, H2 title, subtitle, × close) and a scrolling body. Wide variant for 360 drawers.
2. **Report editor**: head (eyebrow "CONTROLLED REPORT WORKSPACE", title, meta; *Save draft*, *Preview*, *Submit for approval*, ×) → three columns: left sidebar (*Document outline*, *Document controls*), centre canvas (toolbar + editable page), right inspector (*Live data bindings*, *Approval route*, note).
3. **Preview**: head (eyebrow "DOCUMENT PREVIEW", title, "Exactly what the published document will contain."; *Back to edit*, *Print / PDF*, ×) → paper.
4. **Document modal**: head (eyebrow "DOCUMENT VAULT", title, meta; *Edit*, *Create new version*, *Export*, ×) → left aside (*Metadata*, *Access*, *Version history*, *Lifecycle* in live mode) + document preview.
5. **Broker modal**: head (eyebrow "APPROVED TRANSMISSION CHANNEL", H2 "Broker instruction preview", "Structured email generated from the approved order record.", ×) → email preview → footer (*Close*, *Send via approved email*).
6. **Toast stack**: bottom-right stack of transient notifications.

##### States
- Empty: global search drawer with no match → "No matching records" / "Try a client name, security ticker, order reference or document title." Order approval workbench with an empty queue → "Queue clear". [O]
- Loading: the live document lifecycle panel appears after the document fetch; nothing is shown before it. [O]
- Error: bridge failures → toast "Not saved" / {message}. [O]
- Disabled: broker *Send via approved email* (rule above). Lifecycle buttons are shown only for the permitted status transitions. [O]
- Conditional: broker email wording depends on approval. The document preview body depends on type. The live version list replaces the static one. [O]

##### Business rules & calculations
- Only one drawer instance exists; opening another drawer replaces its content (no stacking). [O]
- `closeModals()` closes every open modal together with the backdrop. [O]
- Broker transmission requires an Approved order and `orders.route` (BR-003, BR-019). [O]
- Document approval and publication follow maker ≠ checker when the policies `document_approval` / `client_publish_approval` are on (live API). [O]
- Toasts auto-dismiss after 3.6 s. [O]

##### Edge cases
- The actions *preview-broker-email* / *preview-order* clear the current order, so they always render a DRAFT preview with *Send* disabled. [O]
- The editor document controls (period, currency, classification) do not change content. Currency defaults to ZWG. [O]
- The prototype version history is the same v3/v2/v1 list for every document. [O]
- Toast text is inserted as HTML; user-supplied values (for example folder names) are not escaped. [O]

##### Gaps, defects & open questions
- **DEF-314** The report editor's *Save draft*, *Submit for approval* and "Autosave on" persist nothing and create no approval task. The data bindings and the override marking are static.
- **DEF-315** The document outline buttons only change the highlight; they do not scroll to the section.
- **DEF-316** The prototype version history is static and not tied to the document.
- **DEF-317** Toast messages are rendered as unescaped HTML (injection risk with user-entered names).
- **DEF-318** The drawer has no focus trap and does not return focus to the opener on close.
- FR-DOC-023: Report editor persists versions, binds numeric fields to approved data for the chosen period and currency, and flags manual overrides. — AC: changing *Reporting currency* to USD re-renders the bound values; an edited bound number shows an "override" marker and is audited.
- FR-PLAT-002: Drawers and modals trap focus, close on Escape, restore focus to the opener, and announce their title to screen readers. — AC: keyboard-only users can open, operate and close every drawer.
